name: Singularity.eventually_mem_of_shrinking_complements
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_of_shrinking_complements {B : Type*} [TopologicalSpace B] [T1Space B]
    (T : ℕ → Set B) (Z : Set B)
    (hshrink : ∀ U : Set B, IsOpen U → Z ⊆ U → ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (T n)ᶜ ⊆ U)
    {ξ : B} (hξ : ξ ∉ Z) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ξ ∈ T n

name: Singularity.finite_corrected_eventual_cover_of_finite_exceptional_set
statement:
theorem finite_corrected_eventual_cover_of_finite_exceptional_set
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace B] [CompactSpace B] [T1Space B]
    [MulAction Γ B] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ B]
    (horbit : ∀ ξ : B, (MulAction.orbit Γ ξ).Infinite)
    (T : ℕ → Set B) {Z : Set B} (hZ : Z.Finite)
    (hshrink : ∀ U : Set B, IsOpen U → Z ⊆ U → ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (T n)ᶜ ⊆ U) :
    ∃ F : Finset Γ, ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a ∈ F, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a⁻¹ • ξ ∈ T n

name: Singularity.finite_corrected_eventual_cover_of_shrinking_complements
statement:
theorem finite_corrected_eventual_cover_of_shrinking_complements
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace B] [CompactSpace B] [T1Space B]
    [MulAction Γ B] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ B]
    (T : ℕ → Set B) (Z : Set B) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (hescape : ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a : Γ, a⁻¹ • ξ ∉ Z)
    (hshrink : ∀ U : Set B, IsOpen U → Z ⊆ U → ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (T n)ᶜ ⊆ U) :
    ∃ F : Finset Γ, ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a ∈ F, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a⁻¹ • ξ ∈ T n

name: Singularity.finite_corrections_avoid_exceptional_neighborhood
statement:
theorem finite_corrections_avoid_exceptional_neighborhood
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace B] [CompactSpace B] [RegularSpace B]
    [MulAction Γ B] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ B]
    (Z : Set B) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (hescape : ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a : Γ, a⁻¹ • ξ ∉ Z) :
    ∃ U : Set B, IsOpen U ∧ Z ⊆ U ∧ ∃ F : Finset Γ,
      ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a ∈ F, a⁻¹ • ξ ∉ U

name: Singularity.finite_eventual_cover_of_adjustable_shadows
statement:
theorem finite_eventual_cover_of_adjustable_shadows
    {Γ B I : Type*} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace B] [CompactSpace B] [RegularSpace B]
    [MulAction Γ B] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ B]
    (T : I → ℕ → Set B) (Z : Set B) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (hescape : ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a : Γ, a⁻¹ • ξ ∉ Z)
    (hshrink : ∀ U : Set B, IsOpen U → Z ⊆ U → ∃ i : I,
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (T i n)ᶜ ⊆ U) :
    ∃ i : I, ∃ F : Finset Γ, ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a ∈ F, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a⁻¹ • ξ ∈ T i n

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_apply_ae
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_apply_ae (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (f : GroupL2 Γ) :
    (rightMarkov s μ f : Γ → ℂ) =ᵐ[Measure.count]
      fun x => ∑ g ∈ s, (μ g : ℂ) * f (x * g)

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_contraction
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_contraction (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (f : GroupL2 Γ) : ‖rightMarkov s μ f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_norm_le_one (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) :
    ‖rightMarkov s μ‖ ≤ 1

name: Singularity.rightTranslation_norm
statement:
theorem rightTranslation_norm (g : Γ) (f : GroupL2 Γ) :
    ‖rightTranslation g f‖ = ‖f‖

name: Singularity.countingDelta_apply
statement: theorem countingDelta_apply (x y : X) : countingDelta x y = if y = x then 1 else 0

name: Singularity.countingDelta_inner
statement: theorem countingDelta_inner (x : X) (f : GroupL2 X) : inner ℂ (countingDelta x) f = f x

name: Singularity.countingDelta_norm
statement: theorem countingDelta_norm (x : X) : ‖countingDelta x‖ = 1

name: Singularity.countingEvaluation_apply
statement: theorem countingEvaluation_apply (x : X) (f : GroupL2 X) : countingEvaluation x f = f x

name: Singularity.countingEvaluation_le
statement: theorem countingEvaluation_le (x : X) (f : GroupL2 X) : ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: Singularity.pairing_tendsto
Singularity.rightMarkov_apply
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_apply (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (f : GroupL2 Γ) (x : Γ) :
    rightMarkov s μ f x = ∑ g ∈ s, (μ g : ℂ) * f (x * g)

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_pow_apply
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_pow_apply (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (f : GroupL2 Γ) (x : Γ) :
    (rightMarkov s μ ^ n) f x =
      ∑ w : WalkWord s n, (walkWeight s μ n w : ℂ) * f (walkEndpoint s n x w)

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_pow_delta
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_pow_delta (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) :
    (rightMarkov s μ ^ n) (countingDelta y) x = (transitionWeight s μ n x y : ℂ)

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_hasSum_one
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_hasSum_one (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) (x : Γ) :
    HasSum (transitionWeight s μ n x) 1

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_le_one (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) : transitionWeight s μ n x y ≤ 1

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_left
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_left (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (z x y : Γ) :
    transitionWeight s μ n (z * x) (z * y) = transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) : 0 ≤ transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_zero
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_zero (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (x y : Γ) :
    transitionWeight s μ 0 x y = if x = y then 1 else 0

name: Singularity.walkEndpoint_left
statement:
theorem walkEndpoint_left (s : Finset Γ) (n : ℕ) (z x : Γ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    walkEndpoint s n (z * x) w = z * walkEndpoint s n x w

name: Singularity.walkGreen_left
statement:
theorem walkGreen_left (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (z x y : Γ) :
    walkGreen s μ (z * x) (z * y) = walkGreen s μ x y

name: Singularity.walkGreen_nonneg
statement:
theorem walkGreen_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (x y : Γ) : 0 ≤ walkGreen s μ x y

name: Singularity.walkWeight_mass
statement:
theorem walkWeight_mass (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ w : WalkWord s n, walkWeight s μ n w = 1

name: Singularity.walkWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem walkWeight_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    0 ≤ walkWeight s μ n w

name: Singularity.exists_transitionWeight_pos
statement:
theorem exists_transitionWeight_pos (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (x y : Γ) :
    ∃ n, 0 < transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.exists_walkWord_between
statement:
theorem exists_walkWord_between (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (x y : Γ) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n), walkEndpoint s n x w = y

name: Singularity.exists_walkWord_of_mem_closure
Singularity.transitionWeight_pos_of_path
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_pos_of_path (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) (x y : Γ)
    (hw : walkEndpoint s n x w = y) : 0 < transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.walkWeight_le_transition
statement:
theorem walkWeight_le_transition (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) (x : Γ) :
    walkWeight s μ n w ≤ transitionWeight s μ n x (walkEndpoint s n x w)

name: Singularity.walkWeight_pos
statement:
theorem walkWeight_pos (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    0 < walkWeight s μ n w

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_comparison
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_comparison (s t : Finset Γ)
    (hs : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (ht : Submonoid.closure (t : Set Γ) = ⊤) :
    ∃ L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ x y, jumpDistance s hs x y ≤ L * jumpDistance t ht x y

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_eq_zero_iff (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x y : Γ) : jumpDistance s hgen x y = 0 ↔ x = y

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_jump_le_one
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_jump_le_one (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x : Γ) {g : Γ} (hg : g ∈ s) : jumpDistance s hgen x (x * g) ≤ 1

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_le_length
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_le_length (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) (x y : Γ) (hw : walkEndpoint s n x w = y) :
    jumpDistance s hgen x y ≤ n

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_left
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_left (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (g x y : Γ) : jumpDistance s hgen (g * x) (g * y) = jumpDistance s hgen x y

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_realized
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_realized (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x y : Γ) : ∃ w : WalkWord s (jumpDistance s hgen x y),
      walkEndpoint s (jumpDistance s hgen x y) x w = y

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_triangle (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x y z : Γ) : jumpDistance s hgen x z ≤ jumpDistance s hgen x y + jumpDistance s hgen y z

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_word_bound
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_word_bound (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (t : Finset Γ) (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ g ∈ t, jumpDistance s hgen 1 g ≤ L)
    (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord t n) (x : Γ) :
    jumpDistance s hgen x (walkEndpoint t n x w) ≤ L * n

name: Singularity.walkEndpoint_append
statement:
theorem walkEndpoint_append (s : Finset Γ) (n m : ℕ)
    (w : WalkWord s n) (v : WalkWord s m) (x : Γ) :
    walkEndpoint s (m + n) x (walkWordAppend s n m w v) =
      walkEndpoint s m (walkEndpoint s n x w) v

name: Singularity.firstEntranceKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem firstEntranceKernel_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) :
    0 ≤ firstEntranceKernel s μ A x a

name: Singularity.firstEntranceKernel_of_mem
statement:
theorem firstEntranceKernel_of_mem (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : Set Γ) {x : Γ} (hx : x ∈ A) (a : Γ) :
    firstEntranceKernel s μ A x a = if x = a then 1 else 0

name: Singularity.firstEntranceWeight_le_transition
statement:
theorem firstEntranceWeight_le_transition (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (n : ℕ) (x a : Γ) :
    firstEntranceWeight s μ A n x a ≤ transitionWeight s μ n x a

name: Singularity.firstEntranceWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem firstEntranceWeight_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (n : ℕ) (x a : Γ) :
    0 ≤ firstEntranceWeight s μ A n x a

name: Singularity.firstEntranceWeight_succ_of_mem
statement:
theorem firstEntranceWeight_succ_of_mem (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : Set Γ) {x : Γ} (hx : x ∈ A) (n : ℕ) (a : Γ) :
    firstEntranceWeight s μ A (n + 1) x a = 0

name: Singularity.firstEntranceWeight_succ_of_notMem
statement:
theorem firstEntranceWeight_succ_of_notMem (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : Set Γ) {x : Γ} (hx : x ∉ A) (n : ℕ) (a : Γ) :
    firstEntranceWeight s μ A (n + 1) x a =
      ∑ g ∈ s, μ g * firstEntranceWeight s μ A n (x * g) a

name: Singularity.firstEntranceWeight_zero
statement:
theorem firstEntranceWeight_zero (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) :
    firstEntranceWeight s μ A 0 x a = if x = a ∧ a ∈ A then 1 else 0

name: Singularity.counting_add_apply
statement: theorem counting_add_apply (f g : GroupL2 X) (x : X) : (f + g) x = f x + g x

name: Singularity.counting_smul_apply
statement: theorem counting_smul_apply (c : ℂ) (f : GroupL2 X) (x : X) : (c • f) x = c * f x

name: Singularity.counting_sub_apply
statement: theorem counting_sub_apply (f g : GroupL2 X) (x : X) : (f - g) x = f x - g x

name: Singularity.supportedL2_closed
statement: theorem supportedL2_closed (A : Set X) : IsClosed (supportedL2 A : Set (GroupL2 X))

name: Singularity.supportedRestriction_apply
statement:
theorem supportedRestriction_apply (A : Set X) (f : GroupL2 X) (a : A) :
    ((supportedRestriction A f : supportedL2 A) : GroupL2 X) a = f a

name: Singularity.supportedRestriction_inclusion
statement:
theorem supportedRestriction_inclusion (A : Set X) (f : supportedL2 A) :
    supportedRestriction A (supportedInclusion A f) = f

name: Singularity.supported_compression_apply
statement:
theorem supported_compression_apply (A : Set X) (T : GroupL2 X →L[ℂ] GroupL2 X)
    (f : supportedL2 A) (a : A) :
    ((compression (supportedInclusion A) T f : supportedL2 A) : GroupL2 X) a =
      T (f : GroupL2 X) a

name: Singularity.killedGreen_nonneg
statement:
theorem killedGreen_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (x y : Γ) : 0 ≤ killedGreen s μ A x y

name: Singularity.killedGreen_of_mem
statement:
theorem killedGreen_of_mem (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : Set Γ) {x : Γ} (hx : x ∈ A) (y : Γ) : killedGreen s μ A x y = 0

name: Singularity.killedWeight_le_transition
statement:
theorem killedWeight_le_transition (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) :
    killedWeight s μ A n x y ≤ transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.killedWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem killedWeight_nonneg (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) :
    0 ≤ killedWeight s μ A n x y

name: Singularity.killedWeight_of_mem
statement:
theorem killedWeight_of_mem (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : Set Γ) {x : Γ} (hx : x ∈ A) (n : ℕ) (y : Γ) : killedWeight s μ A n x y = 0

name: Singularity.killedWeight_succ
statement:
theorem killedWeight_succ (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : Set Γ) {x : Γ} (hx : x ∉ A) (n : ℕ) (y : Γ) :
    killedWeight s μ A (n + 1) x y = ∑ g ∈ s, μ g * killedWeight s μ A n (x * g) y

name: Singularity.killedWeight_zero
statement:
theorem killedWeight_zero (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (A : Set Γ) (x y : Γ) :
    killedWeight s μ A 0 x y = if x = y ∧ y ∉ A then 1 else 0

name: Singularity.finiteEndpointLaw_apply
statement:
theorem finiteEndpointLaw_apply (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) :
    finiteEndpointLaw s μ hμ hmass n x y = ENNReal.ofReal (transitionWeight s μ n x y)

name: Singularity.finiteEndpointLaw_toReal
statement:
theorem finiteEndpointLaw_toReal (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) :
    (finiteEndpointLaw s μ hμ hmass n x y).toReal = transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.finiteWalkLaw_apply
statement:
theorem finiteWalkLaw_apply (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    finiteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass n w = ENNReal.ofReal (walkWeight s μ n w)

name: Singularity.walkGreen_eq_sum_endpoint_probabilities
statement:
theorem walkGreen_eq_sum_endpoint_probabilities (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (x y : Γ) :
    walkGreen s μ x y = ∑' n : ℕ, (finiteEndpointLaw s μ hμ hmass n x y).toReal

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_coordinate
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_coordinate (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (fun ω : ℕ → s => ω n) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      (supportJumpLaw s μ hμ hmass).toMeasure

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_firstCoordinates
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_firstCoordinates (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (fun (ω : ℕ → s) (i : Fin n) => ω i.val) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => (supportJumpLaw s μ hμ hmass).toMeasure)

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_independent
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_independent (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) :
    iIndepFun (fun n (ω : ℕ → s) => ω n) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_prefix
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_prefix (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (walkPrefix s n) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      (finiteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass n).toMeasure

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_prefix_probability
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_prefix_probability (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass {ω | walkPrefix s n ω = w} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (walkWeight s μ n w)

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_shift
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_shift (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (k : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (fun (ω : ℕ → s) n => ω (n + k)) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass

name: Singularity.measurable_walkPrefix
statement:
theorem measurable_walkPrefix (S : Type*) [Fintype S] [MeasurableSpace S]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass S] (n : ℕ) : Measurable (walkPrefix S n)

name: Singularity.supportJumpLaw_apply
statement:
theorem supportJumpLaw_apply (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (g : s) :
    supportJumpLaw s μ hμ hmass g = ENNReal.ofReal (μ g)

name: Singularity.walkPrefix_succ
statement:
theorem walkPrefix_succ (S : Type*) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → S) :
    walkPrefix S (n + 1) ω = (ω 0, walkPrefix S n (fun k => ω (k + 1)))

name: Singularity.walkWeight_eq_fin_prod
statement:
theorem walkWeight_eq_fin_prod (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    walkWeight s μ n w = ∏ i : Fin n, μ (walkWordEquivFin s n w i)

name: Singularity.walkWordEquivFin_succ
statement:
theorem walkWordEquivFin_succ (S : Type*) (n : ℕ) (g : S) (w : WalkWord S n) :
    walkWordEquivFin S (n + 1) (g, w) = Fin.cons g (walkWordEquivFin S n w)

name: Singularity.lintegral_walkVisitCount
statement:
theorem lintegral_walkVisitCount (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (x y : Γ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, walkVisitCount s x y ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass =
      ∑' n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (transitionWeight s μ n x y)

name: Singularity.measurableSet_walkPosition
statement:
theorem measurableSet_walkPosition (s : Finset Γ) (x y : Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {ω : ℕ → s | walkPosition s x n ω = y}

name: Singularity.measurable_walkPosition
statement:
theorem measurable_walkPosition (s : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (walkPosition s x n)

name: Singularity.measurable_walkVisitCount
statement:
theorem measurable_walkVisitCount (s : Finset Γ) (x y : Γ) :
    Measurable (walkVisitCount s x y)

name: Singularity.walkPosition_law
statement:
theorem walkPosition_law (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (x : Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (walkPosition s x n) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      (finiteEndpointLaw s μ hμ hmass n x).toMeasure

name: Singularity.walkPosition_left
statement:
theorem walkPosition_left (s : Finset Γ) (z x : Γ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    walkPosition s (z * x) n ω = z * walkPosition s x n ω

name: Singularity.walkPosition_probability
statement:
theorem walkPosition_probability (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (x y : Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass {ω | walkPosition s x n ω = y} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (transitionWeight s μ n x y)

name: Singularity.walkPosition_succ
statement:
theorem walkPosition_succ (s : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    walkPosition s x (n + 1) ω = walkPosition s (x * ω 0) n (fun k => ω (k + 1))

name: Singularity.walkPosition_zero
statement: theorem walkPosition_zero (s : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (ω : ℕ → s) : walkPosition s x 0 ω = x

name: Singularity.ae_eventually_notMem_of_real_bound
statement:
theorem ae_eventually_notMem_of_real_bound {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (ρ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure ρ] (A : ℕ → Set Ω) (b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : Summable b) (hbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ρ (A n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b n)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂ρ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ω ∉ A n

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_le_power_norm
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_le_power_norm (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ) : transitionWeight s μ n x y ≤ ‖rightMarkov s μ ^ n‖

name: Singularity.walkPosition_finite_probability_le
statement:
theorem walkPosition_finite_probability_le (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (x : Γ) (n : ℕ) (A : Finset Γ) :
    infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass {ω | walkPosition s x n ω ∈ A} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((A.card : ℝ) * ‖rightMarkov s μ ^ n‖)

name: Singularity.walk_ae_avoid_slow_sets
statement:
theorem walk_ae_avoid_slow_sets (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (x : Γ)
    (A : ℕ → Finset Γ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (a q : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hsmall : Real.exp a * q < 1)
    (hcard : ∀ n, ((A n).card : ℝ) ≤ K * Real.exp (a * n))
    (hpower : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ‖rightMarkov s μ ^ n‖ ≤ q ^ n) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, walkPosition s x n ω ∉ A n

name: Singularity.exists_positive_jumpWeight_lower
statement:
theorem exists_positive_jumpWeight_lower (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, 0 < p ∧ p < 1 ∧ ∀ g ∈ s, p ≤ μ g

name: Singularity.transitionWeight_zero_of_lt_jumpDistance
statement:
theorem transitionWeight_zero_of_lt_jumpDistance (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (x y : Γ) (n : ℕ)

name: Singularity.walkWeight_ge_pow
statement:
theorem walkWeight_ge_pow (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)

name: Singularity.contraction_fixed_of_defect_inner_zero
statement:
theorem contraction_fixed_of_defect_inner_zero {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

name: Singularity.killedGreen_eq_zero_of_separator
statement:
theorem killedGreen_eq_zero_of_separator (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)

name: Singularity.supportedL2_eq_sum_delta
statement:
theorem supportedL2_eq_sum_delta {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    (A : Finset X) (u : supportedL2 (A : Set X)) :
    u = ∑ a : A, (u : GroupL2 X) a • supportedDelta (A : Set X) a

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_adjoint
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_adjoint (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) :
    (rightMarkov s μ).adjoint =
      ∑ g ∈ s, (μ g : ℂ) • (rightTranslation g⁻¹).toContinuousLinearMap

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_adjoint_apply_ae
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_adjoint_apply_ae (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (f : GroupL2 Γ) :
    ((rightMarkov s μ).adjoint f : Γ → ℂ) =ᵐ[Measure.count]
      fun x => ∑ g ∈ s, (μ g : ℂ) * f (x * g⁻¹)

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_adjoint_eq_reflected
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_adjoint_eq_reflected (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) :
    (rightMarkov s μ).adjoint =
      rightMarkov (s.map ⟨Inv.inv, inv_injective⟩) (fun g => μ g⁻¹)

name: Singularity.rightTranslation_adjoint
statement:
theorem rightTranslation_adjoint (g : Γ) :
    (rightTranslation g).toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint =
      (rightTranslation g⁻¹).toContinuousLinearMap

name: Singularity.rightTranslation_apply_ae
statement:
theorem rightTranslation_apply_ae (g : Γ) (f : GroupL2 Γ) :
    (rightTranslation g f : Γ → ℂ) =ᵐ[Measure.count] fun x => f (x * g)

name: Singularity.rightTranslation_mul
statement:
theorem rightTranslation_mul (g h : Γ) (f : GroupL2 Γ) :
    rightTranslation g (rightTranslation h f) = rightTranslation (g * h) f

name: Singularity.rightTranslation_one
statement: theorem rightTranslation_one (f : GroupL2 Γ) : rightTranslation (1 : Γ) f = f

name: Singularity.green_adjoint
statement: theorem green_adjoint (P : E →L[ℂ] E) : (green P).adjoint = green P.adjoint

name: Singularity.reflected_green_operator
statement:
theorem reflected_green_operator (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) :

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_head_tail
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_head_tail (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) :
    Measure.map (fun ω : ℕ → s => (ω 0, fun n => ω (n + 1)))
      (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      (supportJumpLaw s μ hμ hmass).toMeasure.prod (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_head_tail_independent
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_head_tail_independent (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) :
    IndepFun (fun ω : ℕ → s => ω 0) (fun ω n => ω (n + 1))
      (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_lintegral_head_tail
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_lintegral_head_tail (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (f : s × (ℕ → s) → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ ω, f (ω 0, fun n => ω (n + 1)) ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) *
        ∫⁻ ω, f (g, ω) ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLimit_first_step
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLimit_first_step (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (orbit : Γ → B) (horbit : ∀ g h, orbit (g * h) = g • orbit h)
    (b : (ℕ → s) → B)
    (hlimit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (b ω))) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      b ω = (ω 0 : Γ) • b (fun k => ω (k + 1))

name: Singularity.walkPosition_add
statement:
theorem walkPosition_add (s : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (m n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    walkPosition s x (m + n) ω = walkPosition s x m ω *
      walkPosition s 1 n (fun k => ω (k + m))

name: Singularity.walkPosition_first_step
statement:
theorem walkPosition_first_step (s : Finset Γ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    walkPosition s 1 (n + 1) ω = (ω 0 : Γ) *
      walkPosition s 1 n (fun k => ω (k + 1))

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_head_tail_map
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_head_tail_map (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (f : s × (ℕ → s) → B) (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measure.map (fun ω : ℕ → s => f (ω 0, fun n => ω (n + 1)))
      (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass) =
      ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) •
        Measure.map (fun ω => f (g, ω)) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLaw_probability
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLaw_probability (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (b : (ℕ → s) → B) (hb : Measurable b) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b)

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLaw_stationary
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLaw_stationary (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (b : (ℕ → s) → B) (hb : Measurable b)
    (hstep : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      b ω = (ω 0 : Γ) • b (fun n => ω (n + 1))) :
    walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b =
      ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) •
        Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) (walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b)

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLaw_stationary_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLaw_stationary_of_tendsto
    [TopologicalSpace B] [T2Space B] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ B]
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (orbit : Γ → B) (horbit : ∀ g h, orbit (g * h) = g • orbit h)
    (b : (ℕ → s) → B) (hb : Measurable b)
    (hlimit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (b ω))) :
    walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b =
      ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) •
        Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) (walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b)

name: Singularity.stationary_generated_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem stationary_generated_absolutelyContinuous (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (ν : Measure B)
    (hstat : ν = ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν)
    {g : Γ} (hg : g ∈ Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ)) :
    Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν ≪ ν

name: Singularity.stationary_jump_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem stationary_jump_absolutelyContinuous (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (ν : Measure B)
    (hstat : ν = ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν)
    (g : s) : Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν ≪ ν

name: Singularity.stationary_jump_domination
statement:
theorem stationary_jump_domination (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (ν : Measure B)
    (hstat : ν = ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν)
    (g : s) : ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν ≤ ν

name: Singularity.stationary_translate_equivalent
statement:
theorem stationary_translate_equivalent (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (ν : Measure B)
    (hstat : ν = ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν)
    (g : Γ) : Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν ≪ ν ∧
      ν ≪ Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν

name: Singularity.measurable_stationaryDensity
statement:
theorem measurable_stationaryDensity (ν : Measure B) (g : Γ) :
    Measurable (stationaryDensity ν g)

name: Singularity.stationaryDensity_cocycle
statement:
theorem stationaryDensity_cocycle (g h : Γ) :
    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, stationaryDensity ν (g * h) ξ =
      stationaryDensity ν g ξ * stationaryDensity ν h (g⁻¹ • ξ)

name: Singularity.stationaryDensity_one
statement: theorem stationaryDensity_one : stationaryDensity ν (1 : Γ) =ᵐ[ν] fun _ => 1

name: Singularity.stationaryDensity_positive_finite
statement:
theorem stationaryDensity_positive_finite (g : Γ) :
    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, 0 < stationaryDensity ν g ξ ∧ stationaryDensity ν g ξ < ∞

name: Singularity.stationaryDensity_withDensity
statement:
theorem stationaryDensity_withDensity (g : Γ) :
    ν.withDensity (stationaryDensity ν g) = Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν

name: Singularity.map_withDensity_equiv
statement:
theorem map_withDensity_equiv (e : X ≃ᵐ Y) (μ : Measure X)
    (K : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hK : Measurable K) :
    Measure.map e (μ.withDensity K) =
      (Measure.map e μ).withDensity (fun y => K (e.symm y))

name: Singularity.weightedProduct_invariant
statement:
theorem weightedProduct_invariant (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (f : Y ≃ᵐ Y)
    (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    (rX : X → ℝ≥0∞) (rY : Y → ℝ≥0∞) (K : X × Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hrX : Measurable rX) (hrY : Measurable rY) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hμ : Measure.map e μ = μ.withDensity rX)
    (hν : Measure.map f ν = ν.withDensity rY)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.prod ν, rX z.1 * rY z.2 * K (e.symm z.1, f.symm z.2) = K z) :
    Measure.map (e.prodCongr f) ((μ.prod ν).withDensity K) =
      (μ.prod ν).withDensity K

name: Singularity.weightedProduct_invariant_of_div
statement:
theorem weightedProduct_invariant_of_div (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (f : Y ≃ᵐ Y)
    (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    (rX : X → ℝ) (rY : Y → ℝ) (K : X × Y → ℝ)
    (hrX : Measurable rX) (hrY : Measurable rY) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hpX : ∀ x, 0 < rX x) (hpY : ∀ y, 0 < rY y)
    (hμ : Measure.map e μ = μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (rX x)))
    (hν : Measure.map f ν = ν.withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (rY y)))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.prod ν, K (e.symm z.1, f.symm z.2) = K z / (rX z.1 * rY z.2)) :
    Measure.map (e.prodCongr f) ((μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (K z))) =
      (μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (K z))

name: Singularity.stationaryRealDensity_withDensity
statement:
theorem stationaryRealDensity_withDensity (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (α : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure α]
    (hs : α = ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun x : X => (g : Γ) • x) α)
    (g : Γ) : α.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (stationaryRealDensity α g x)) =
      Measure.map (fun x : X => g • x) α

name: Singularity.stationary_weightedProduct_invariant
statement:
theorem stationary_weightedProduct_invariant
    (s t : Finset Γ) (μ ν : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (hν : ∀ g ∈ t, 0 < ν g)
    (hgs : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (hgt : Submonoid.closure (t : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (α : Measure X) (β : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasure α] [IsFiniteMeasure β]
    (hs : α = ∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun x : X => (g : Γ) • x) α)
    (ht : β = ∑ g : t, ENNReal.ofReal (ν g) • Measure.map (fun y : Y => (g : Γ) • y) β)
    (K : X × Y → ℝ) (hK : Measurable K) (g : Γ)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ p ∂α.prod β, K (g⁻¹ • p.1, g⁻¹ • p.2) =
      K p / (stationaryRealDensity α g p.1 * stationaryRealDensity β g p.2)) :
    Measure.map (fun p : X × Y => (g • p.1, g • p.2))
      ((α.prod β).withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (K p))) =
      (α.prod β).withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (K p))

name: Singularity.weightedProduct_invariant_of_div_ae
statement:
theorem weightedProduct_invariant_of_div_ae {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (f : Y ≃ᵐ Y) (α : Measure X) (β : Measure Y) [SFinite α] [SFinite β]
    (rX : X → ℝ) (rY : Y → ℝ) (K : X × Y → ℝ)
    (hrX : Measurable rX) (hrY : Measurable rY) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hpX : ∀ᵐ x ∂α, 0 < rX x) (hpY : ∀ᵐ y ∂β, 0 < rY y)
    (hα : Measure.map e α = α.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (rX x)))
    (hβ : Measure.map f β = β.withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (rY y)))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ p ∂α.prod β, K (e.symm p.1, f.symm p.2) = K p / (rX p.1 * rY p.2)) :
    Measure.map (e.prodCongr f) ((α.prod β).withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (K p))) =
      (α.prod β).withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (K p))

name: Singularity.firstEntrance_partial_superharmonic_bound
statement:
theorem firstEntrance_partial_superharmonic_bound
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g)
    (h : Γ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x)
    (hh : ∀ x, ∑ g ∈ s, μ g * h (x * g) ≤ h x) (y : Γ) (N : ℕ) (x : Γ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, firstEntranceWeight s μ {y} n x y) * h y ≤ h x

name: Singularity.greenDistance_left
statement:
theorem greenDistance_left (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (g x y : Γ) :

name: Singularity.walkGreen_diagonal_eq
statement:
theorem walkGreen_diagonal_eq (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (x : Γ) :

name: Singularity.measurable_stationaryLogCocycle

theorem measurable_stationaryLogCocycle (ν : Measure B) (g : Γ) :

name: Singularity.stationaryLogCocycle_one
statement: theorem stationaryLogCocycle_one : stationaryLogCocycle ν (1 : Γ) =ᵐ[ν] fun _ => 0

name: Singularity.stationaryRealDensity_cocycle
statement:
theorem stationaryRealDensity_cocycle (g h : Γ) :
    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, stationaryRealDensity ν (g * h) ξ =
      stationaryRealDensity ν g ξ * stationaryRealDensity ν h (g⁻¹ • ξ)

name: Singularity.stationaryLogCocycle_change_measure
statement:
theorem stationaryLogCocycle_change_measure (ν m : Measure B)
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m] (hac : ν ≪ m)
    (hν : ∀ g : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (hm : ∀ g : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) m ≪ m) (g : Γ) :
    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ = stationaryLogCocycle m g ξ +
      Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv m ξ).toReal) - Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv m (g • ξ)).toReal)

    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂m, stationaryRealDensity ν g ξ * (ν.rnDeriv m ξ).toReal =

name: Singularity.finiteBand_norm_sq

name: Singularity.finiteBand_periodic_pairing_zero
statement:
theorem finiteBand_periodic_pairing_zero {d : ℕ} (q : ℝ)
    {v : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d)} (hv : Measurable v)
    (hnorm : ∀ ω, ‖v ω‖ = 1) {h w : ℝ → ℂ} (hh : MemLp h 2 volume)
    (hw : Measurable w) (hwbound : ∀ t, ‖w t‖ ≤ 1)
    (hperiod : ∀ ω (l : Fin d), w (ω + (l : ℕ) * q) = w ω)
    (hker : ∀ ω ∈ Ico 0 q, ∑ l : Fin d, conj (h (ω + (l : ℕ) * q)) * v ω l = 0) :

name: Singularity.frequency_kernel_pairing_zero
statement:
theorem frequency_kernel_pairing_zero {N : ℕ} (k : Fin N → RealLineL2) (q : ℝ)

    (j : Fin N) {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : Measurable w) (hwbound : ∀ t, ‖w t‖ ≤ 1)
    (hperiod : ∀ ω (l : Fin (N + 1)), w (ω + (l : ℕ) * q) = w ω) :
    ∫ t, (w t * conj ((Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ (k j) : ℝ → ℂ) t)) *

name: Singularity.integral_mul_bandPiece

name: Singularity.integral_mul_finiteBand

name: Singularity.translated_analysis_apply
statement:
theorem translated_analysis_apply {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (k : J → ℝ → ℝ) (C : J → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j) (hk : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ k j t)
    (hint : ∀ j, Integrable (k j))
    (hmass : ∀ j, ∫ t, k j t ≤ 1)
    (hdecay : ∀ j t, k j t ≤ C j * Real.exp (-|t|))
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (n : ℤ) (j : J) :
    (translatedDensityFamily hτ k C hC hk hint hmass hdecay).analysis f (n, j) =
      ∫ t, (k j (t - (n : ℝ) * τ) : ℂ) * f t

name: Singularity.translated_analysis_norm_le
statement:
theorem translated_analysis_norm_le {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (k : J → ℝ → ℝ) (C : J → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j) (hk : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ k j t)
    (hint : ∀ j, Integrable (k j))
    (hmass : ∀ j, ∫ t, k j t ≤ 1)
    (hdecay : ∀ j t, k j t ≤ C j * Real.exp (-|t|)) :
    ‖(translatedDensityFamily hτ k C hC hk hint hmass hdecay).analysis‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((∑ j, C j) * latticeEnvelopeBound τ)

name: Singularity.translated_profiles_overlap
statement:
theorem translated_profiles_overlap {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (k : J → ℝ → ℝ) (C : J → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j) (hk : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ k j t)
    (hdecay : ∀ j t, k j t ≤ C j * Real.exp (-|t|))
    (s : Finset (ℤ × J)) (t : ℝ) :
    ∑ p ∈ s, k p.2 (t - (p.1 : ℝ) * τ) ≤
      (∑ j, C j) * latticeEnvelopeBound τ

name: Singularity.impossible_translated_analysis_factorization
statement:
theorem impossible_translated_analysis_factorization {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (k : J → ℝ → ℝ) (C : J → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j) (hk : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ k j t)
    (hint : ∀ j, Integrable (k j)) (hmass : ∀ j, ∫ t, k j t ≤ 1)
    (hdecay : ∀ j t, k j t ≤ C j * Real.exp (-|t|))
    (T : RealLineL2 →L[ℂ] RealLineL2)
    (M : SequenceL2 (ℤ × J) →L[ℂ] SequenceL2 (ℤ × J))
    (L : SequenceL2 (ℤ × J) →L[ℂ] RealLineL2)
    (hT : Function.Injective T)
    (hfactor : T = L.comp (M.comp
      (translatedDensityFamily hτ k C hC hk hint hmass hdecay).analysis)) : False

name: Singularity.inner_realTranslation_toLp

name: Singularity.translated_analysis_has_kernel
statement:
theorem translated_analysis_has_kernel {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (k : J → ℝ → ℝ) (C : J → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j) (hk : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ k j t)

    (hdecay : ∀ j t, k j t ≤ C j * Real.exp (-|t|)) :

      (translatedDensityFamily hτ k C hC hk hint hmass hdecay).analysis φ = 0

name: Singularity.ergodicSMul_ae_eq_const

name: Singularity.ergodic_current_density_identity
statement:
theorem ergodic_current_density_identity {G : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    [MeasurableConstSMul G X] (m : Measure X) [SigmaFinite m] [NeZero m]
    (F L : X → ℝ) (hF : Measurable F) (hL : Measurable L)
    (hpF : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, 0 < F x) (hpL : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, 0 < L x)
    [ErgodicSMul G X (m.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (L x)))]
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Measure.map (fun x => g • x)
      (m.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x))) =
      m.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x))) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂m, F x = c * L x

name: Singularity.positive_real_weight_measureClass
statement:
theorem positive_real_weight_measureClass (m : Measure X) (w : X → ℝ)
    (hw : Measurable w) (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, 0 < w x) :
    m.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)) ≪ m ∧

name: Singularity.real_density_eq_of_measure_eq_smul

theorem real_density_eq_of_measure_eq_smul (m : Measure X) [SigmaFinite m]

    (hpF : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, 0 ≤ F x) (hpL : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, 0 ≤ L x) (c : ℝ≥0∞)
    (heq : m.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
      c • m.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (L x))) :

name: Singularity.weightedProduct_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem weightedProduct_absolutelyContinuous
    (μ μ₀ : Measure X) (ν ν₀ : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] [SFinite ν₀]
    (hμ : μ ≪ μ₀) (hν : ν ≪ ν₀) (K L : X × Y → ℝ)
    (hL : Measurable L) (hpL : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ₀.prod ν₀, 0 < L z) :
    (μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (K z)) ≪
      (μ₀.prod ν₀).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (L z))

name: Singularity.weightedProduct_measureClass
statement:
theorem weightedProduct_measureClass
    (μ μ₀ : Measure X) (ν ν₀ : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] [SFinite ν₀]
    (hμ : μ ≪ μ₀) (hμ' : μ₀ ≪ μ) (hν : ν ≪ ν₀) (hν' : ν₀ ≪ ν)
    (K L : X × Y → ℝ) (hK : Measurable K) (hL : Measurable L)
    (hpK : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.prod ν, 0 < K z) (hpL : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ₀.prod ν₀, 0 < L z) :
    (μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (K z)) ≪
      (μ₀.prod ν₀).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (L z)) ∧
    (μ₀.prod ν₀).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (L z)) ≪
      (μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (K z))

name: Singularity.weightedProduct_real_density
statement:
theorem weightedProduct_real_density (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
    [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] (f : X → ℝ) (g : Y → ℝ) (K : X × Y → ℝ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) (hK : Measurable K)
    (hpf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hpg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ g y) :
    ((μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x))).prod
      (ν.withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (g y)))).withDensity
      (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (K z)) =
    (μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (f z.1 * g z.2 * K z))

name: Singularity.logBoundaryPair_liouville_map
statement:

        (Real.cosh (dist z UpperHalfPlane.I / 2) * Real.cosh (dist w UpperHalfPlane.I / 2))

name: Singularity.halfPlaneCayley_dist_le
statement:
theorem halfPlaneCayley_dist_le (z w : ℍ) (L : ℝ) (hL : dist z w ≤ L) :
    dist (halfPlaneCayley z) (halfPlaneCayley w) ≤
      4 * Real.exp L * Real.exp (-dist z UpperHalfPlane.I)

name: Singularity.halfPlaneCayley_sub
statement:
theorem halfPlaneCayley_sub (z w : ℍ) :
    halfPlaneCayley z - halfPlaneCayley w =
      (2 * Complex.I) * ((z : ℂ) - (w : ℂ)) / (((z : ℂ) + Complex.I) * ((w : ℂ) + Complex.I))

name: Singularity.sinh_le_exp

name: Singularity.cyclicOrbitEquiv_apply

theorem cyclicOrbitEquiv_apply (a : Γ) (b : J → Γ) (ha : ¬IsOfFinOrder a)

    (cyclicOrbitEquiv a b ha hb p : Γ) = a ^ p.1 * b p.2

name: Singularity.cyclicOrbitEquiv_shift
statement:
theorem cyclicOrbitEquiv_shift (a : Γ) (b : J → Γ) (ha : ¬IsOfFinOrder a)
    (hb : ∀ j k (n : ℤ), a ^ n * b j = b k → j = k) (m n : ℤ) (j : J) :
    a ^ m * (cyclicOrbitEquiv a b ha hb (n, j) : Γ) =
      (cyclicOrbitEquiv a b ha hb (m + n, j) : Γ)

theorem cyclicOrbit_injective (a : Γ) (b : J → Γ) (ha : ¬IsOfFinOrder a)

name: Singularity.boundaryLogDensity_analysis_apply
statement:
theorem boundaryLogDensity_analysis_apply (v : RealLineL2) (n : ℤ) (j : J) :
    (boundaryLogDensityFamily ε hε hτ f x y B hf hpf hmass hy hB hdom).analysis v (n, j) =
      ∫ t, (logBoundaryDensity ε (dilatedBoundaryDensity ((n : ℝ) * τ) (f j)) t : ℂ) * v t

name: Singularity.boundaryLogDensity_analysis_apply_of_map
statement:
theorem boundaryLogDensity_analysis_apply_of_map
    (g : ℤ → J → ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ n j, Measurable (g n j))
    (hpg : ∀ n j u, 0 ≤ g n j u)
    (hmap : ∀ n j, volume.withDensity (fun u => ENNReal.ofReal (g n j u)) =
      Measure.map (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * τ) * u)
        (volume.withDensity (fun u => ENNReal.ofReal (f j u))))
    (v : RealLineL2) (n : ℤ) (j : J) :
    (boundaryLogDensityFamily ε hε hτ f x y B hf hpf hmass hy hB hdom).analysis v (n, j) =
      ∫ t, (logBoundaryDensity ε (g n j) t : ℂ) * v t

name: Singularity.boundaryLogDensity_analysis_has_kernel
statement:
theorem boundaryLogDensity_analysis_has_kernel :
    ∃ v : RealLineL2, v ≠ 0 ∧
      (boundaryLogDensityFamily ε hε hτ f x y B hf hpf hmass hy hB hdom).analysis v = 0

name: Singularity.boundaryMeasure_analysis_apply_of_map
statement:
theorem boundaryMeasure_analysis_apply_of_map
    (g : ℤ → J → ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ n j, Measurable (g n j)) (hpg : ∀ n j u, 0 ≤ g n j u)
    (hmap : ∀ n j, volume.withDensity (fun u => ENNReal.ofReal (g n j u)) =
      Measure.map (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * τ) * u) (ν j))
    (v : RealLineL2) (n : ℤ) (j : J) :
    (boundaryMeasureDensityFamily ε hε hτ ν hac hmass x y B hy hB hbound).analysis v (n, j) =
      ∫ t, (logBoundaryDensity ε (g n j) t : ℂ) * v t

name: Singularity.boundaryMeasure_analysis_has_kernel
statement:
theorem boundaryMeasure_analysis_has_kernel :
    ∃ v : RealLineL2, v ≠ 0 ∧
      (boundaryMeasureDensityFamily ε hε hτ ν hac hmass x y B hy hB hbound).analysis v = 0

name: Singularity.boundaryMeasure_orbit_density

theorem dilationMatrix_smul (t : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :

theorem dilationMatrix_smul_im (t : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :

statement:
theorem dilationMatrix_smul_ratio (t : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :

name: Singularity.dilationMatrix_smul_re

theorem dilationMatrix_smul_re (t : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :

name: Singularity.dilationMatrix_zpow_axis_dist

statement:

theorem finiteJumpLengthBound_nonneg (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (z : ℍ) (s : Finset Γ) :

name: Singularity.finiteJumpStrip_finite_cyclic_decomposition
statement:
theorem finiteJumpStrip_finite_cyclic_decomposition
    (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology Γ] (s : Finset Γ)
    (a : Γ) {τ : ℝ} (ha : (a : SL(2, ℝ)) = dilationMatrix τ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ), 0 < N ∧ ∃ (b : Fin N → Γ),
      Function.Injective (fun p : ℤ × Fin N => a ^ p.1 * b p.2) ∧
      finiteJumpStrip Γ UpperHalfPlane.I s = cyclicOrbitUnion a b ∧
      ∀ x y : Γ, (x • UpperHalfPlane.I).re < 0 → 0 ≤ (y • UpperHalfPlane.I).re →
        SeparatesJumpPaths s (cyclicOrbitUnion a b) x y

name: Singularity.halfPlaneCayley_dist_lower_of_excess
statement:
theorem halfPlaneCayley_dist_lower_of_excess (z w : ℍ) (D : ℝ)
    (hd : 2 ≤ dist z w)
    (hexcess : dist z UpperHalfPlane.I + dist w UpperHalfPlane.I - dist z w ≤ D) :

name: Singularity.killedWeight_eq_zero_of_short_detour
statement:
theorem killedWeight_eq_zero_of_short_detour (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (R δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ)
    (hsep : δ ≤ dist (halfPlaneCayley (x • UpperHalfPlane.I))
      (halfPlaneCayley (y • UpperHalfPlane.I)))
    (hn : (n : ℝ) < δ / (4 * Real.exp (finiteJumpLengthBound Γ UpperHalfPlane.I s)) * Real.exp R) :
    killedWeight s μ {g : Γ | dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) UpperHalfPlane.I < R} n x y = 0

name: Singularity.orbit_cayley_separation_of_excess

theorem orbit_cayley_separation_of_excess (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    (u x y : Γ) (D : ℝ) (hd : 2 ≤ dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (y • UpperHalfPlane.I))
    (hexcess : dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) +
      dist (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) -
      dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ D) :
    Real.exp (-D / 2) / 4 ≤ dist
      (halfPlaneCayley ((u⁻¹ * x) • UpperHalfPlane.I))
      (halfPlaneCayley ((u⁻¹ * y) • UpperHalfPlane.I))

name: Singularity.walkEndpoint_cayley_detour_bound
statement:
theorem walkEndpoint_cayley_detour_bound (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    (s : Finset Γ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : Γ) (w : WalkWord s n)
    (hw : avoidsBefore s {g : Γ | dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) UpperHalfPlane.I < R}
      n x w) :
    dist (halfPlaneCayley (x • UpperHalfPlane.I))
        (halfPlaneCayley (walkEndpoint s n x w • UpperHalfPlane.I)) ≤
      (n : ℝ) * (4 * Real.exp (finiteJumpLengthBound Γ UpperHalfPlane.I s) * Real.exp (-R))

name: Singularity.walkEndpoint_detour_length
statement:
theorem walkEndpoint_detour_length (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    (s : Finset Γ) (R δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : Γ) (w : WalkWord s n)
    (hw : avoidsBefore s {g : Γ | dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) UpperHalfPlane.I < R}
      n x w)
    (hsep : δ ≤ dist (halfPlaneCayley (x • UpperHalfPlane.I))
      (halfPlaneCayley (walkEndpoint s n x w • UpperHalfPlane.I))) :
    δ / (4 * Real.exp (finiteJumpLengthBound Γ UpperHalfPlane.I s)) * Real.exp R ≤ (n : ℝ)

name: Singularity.halfPlaneCayley_dist_upper_of_excess
statement:
theorem halfPlaneCayley_dist_upper_of_excess (z w : ℍ) :

name: Singularity.finiteBoundaryRay_poisson_bound
statement:

name: Singularity.visualPoisson_eq
statement:
theorem visualPoisson_eq (z : ℍ) (ξ : ℝ) :
    visualPoisson z ξ = z.im * (1 + ξ ^ 2) / ((ξ - z.re) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)

name: Singularity.visualPoisson_eq_density

name: Singularity.axis_balls_excess
statement:
theorem axis_balls_excess (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (a c b r₁ r₂ : ℝ) (x y : ℍ)
    (ha : a + 1 ≤ c) (hb : c + 1 ≤ b)
    (hx : dist x (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ r₁)
    (hy : dist y (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ r₂)
    (hm₁ : r₁ + Real.log 64 ≤ c - a) (hm₂ : r₂ + Real.log 64 ≤ b - c) :
    dist x (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I c) +
      dist y (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I c) - dist x y ≤ 2 * Real.log 32

name: Singularity.cayley_near_axis_bound
statement:
theorem cayley_near_axis_bound (t r : ℝ) (z : ℍ)
    (hz : dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) ≤ r)
    (hmargin : r + Real.log 64 ≤ |t|) :
    dist (halfPlaneCayley (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t)) (halfPlaneCayley z) ≤ 1 / 16

name: Singularity.opposite_axis_balls_excess
statement:
theorem opposite_axis_balls_excess (a b r₁ r₂ : ℝ) (x y : ℍ)
    (ha : a ≤ -1) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hx : dist x (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ r₁)
    (hy : dist y (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ r₂)
    (hm₁ : r₁ + Real.log 64 ≤ -a) (hm₂ : r₂ + Real.log 64 ≤ b) :
    dist x UpperHalfPlane.I + dist y UpperHalfPlane.I - dist x y ≤ 2 * Real.log 32

name: Singularity.opposite_axis_cayley_separation
statement:
theorem opposite_axis_cayley_separation (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ≤ -1) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :

name: Singularity.verticalHeightRay_dist_eq
statement:
theorem verticalHeightRay_dist_eq (w : ℍ) (s t : ℝ) :

name: Singularity.axis_balls_excess_near_center
statement:
theorem axis_balls_excess_near_center (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (a c b r₁ r₂ E : ℝ) (x y o : ℍ)
    (ha : a + 1 ≤ c) (hb : c + 1 ≤ b)
    (hx : dist x (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ r₁)
    (hy : dist y (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ r₂)
    (hm₁ : r₁ + Real.log 64 ≤ c - a) (hm₂ : r₂ + Real.log 64 ≤ b - c)
    (ho : dist (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I c) o ≤ E) :
    dist x o + dist y o - dist x y ≤ 2 * Real.log 32 + 2 * E

name: Singularity.axis_nearby_distance_bounds
statement:
theorem axis_nearby_distance_bounds (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (a b r₁ r₂ : ℝ) (x y : ℍ)
    (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hx : dist x (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ r₁)
    (hy : dist y (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ r₂) :
    b - a - r₁ - r₂ ≤ dist x y ∧ dist x y ≤ b - a + r₁ + r₂

name: Singularity.orbit_axis_ball_pair_geometry
statement:
theorem orbit_axis_ball_pair_geometry (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (a c b r₁ r₂ E : ℝ) (v u w x y : Γ)
    (ha : a + 1 ≤ c) (hb : c + 1 ≤ b)
    (hv : dist (v • UpperHalfPlane.I) (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ E)
    (hu : dist (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I c) ≤ E)
    (hw : dist (w • UpperHalfPlane.I) (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ E)
    (hx : dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (v • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ r₁)
    (hy : dist (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) (w • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ r₂)
    (hm₁ : r₁ + E + Real.log 64 ≤ c - a)
    (hm₂ : r₂ + E + Real.log 64 ≤ b - c) :
    b - a - r₁ - r₂ - 2 * E ≤ dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) ∧
    dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ b - a + r₁ + r₂ + 2 * E ∧
    dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) +
      dist (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) -
      dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 2 * Real.log 32 + 2 * E

name: Singularity.isometry_interval_chain
statement:
theorem isometry_interval_chain (f : ℝ → X) (hf : Isometry f) (a b : ℝ) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → X), p 0 = f a ∧ p n = f b ∧
      (n : ℝ) ≤ |b - a| + 2 ∧ ∀ k < n, dist (p k) (p (k + 1)) ≤ 1

name: Singularity.metric_chain_append
statement:
theorem metric_chain_append (f g : ℕ → X) (n m : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (hjoin : f n = g 0)
    (hf : ∀ k < n, dist (f k) (f (k + 1)) ≤ L)
    (hg : ∀ k < m, dist (g k) (g (k + 1)) ≤ L) :
    ∃ h : ℕ → X, h 0 = f 0 ∧ h (n + m) = g m ∧
      ∀ k < n + m, dist (h k) (h (k + 1)) ≤ L

name: Singularity.axis_orbit_chain_of_cover
statement:
theorem axis_orbit_chain_of_cover (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hcover : ∀ z : ℍ, ∃ g : Γ, dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) z ≤ E)
    (q : SL(2, ℝ)) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (x y : Γ)
    (hx : dist (q • (x • UpperHalfPlane.I)) (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ E)
    (hy : dist (q • (y • UpperHalfPlane.I)) (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ E) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Γ), f 0 = x ∧ f N = y ∧ (N : ℝ) ≤ b-a+4 ∧
      (∀ k < N, dist (f k • UpperHalfPlane.I) (f (k+1) • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 2*E+1) ∧
      ∀ k ≤ N, a-E ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (f k • UpperHalfPlane.I))

name: Singularity.axis_orbit_chain_with_tube
statement:
theorem axis_orbit_chain_with_tube (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (E : ℝ) (_hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hcover : ∀ z : ℍ, ∃ g : Γ, dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) z ≤ E)
    (q : SL(2, ℝ)) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (x y : Γ)
    (hx : dist (q • (x • UpperHalfPlane.I)) (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a) ≤ E)
    (hy : dist (q • (y • UpperHalfPlane.I)) (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b) ≤ E) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Γ), f 0 = x ∧ f N = y ∧ (N : ℝ) ≤ b-a+4 ∧
      (∀ k < N, dist (f k • UpperHalfPlane.I) (f (k+1) • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 2*E+1) ∧
      ∀ k ≤ N, ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
        dist (q • (f k • UpperHalfPlane.I)) (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) ≤ E

name: Singularity.ordered_interval_subdivision

      (∀ k ≤ n, a ≤ τ k ∧ τ k ≤ b) ∧ ∀ k < n, |τ (k+1)-τ k| ≤ 1

name: Singularity.axis_balanced_point
statement:
theorem axis_balanced_point (z : ℍ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    let u := (dist z UpperHalfPlane.I - dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) + t) / 2
    u ∈ Set.Icc 0 t ∧
      dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I u) ≤
        (dist z UpperHalfPlane.I + dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) - t) / 2 + Real.log 4

name: Singularity.cosh_dist_axis
statement:
theorem cosh_dist_axis (z : ℍ) (t : ℝ) :

name: Singularity.cosh_dist_axis_interpolation
statement:

    Real.cosh (dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I u)) ≤
      Real.exp (-u) * Real.cosh (dist z UpperHalfPlane.I) +
      Real.exp (u-t) * Real.cosh (dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t))

name: Singularity.exists_axis_point_of_triangle_excess
statement:
theorem exists_axis_point_of_triangle_excess (x o y : ℍ) (D : ℝ)
    (hexcess : dist x o + dist y o - dist x y ≤ D) :
    ∃ (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (u : ℝ),
      g • UpperHalfPlane.I = x ∧ g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I (dist x y) = y ∧
      u ∈ Set.Icc 0 (dist x y) ∧
      dist (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I u) o ≤ D / 2 + Real.log 4

name: Singularity.block_inverse_identity
statement:
theorem block_inverse_identity
    (C : E →L[𝕜] F) (D V : F →L[𝕜] F)
    (X M : E →L[𝕜] E) (Y : F →L[𝕜] E)
    (Z : E →L[𝕜] F) (W : F →L[𝕜] F)
    (hfirst : ∀ x, C (X x) + D (Z x) = 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ y, C (Y y) + D (W y) = y)
    (hXM : ∀ x, X (M x) = x)
    (hVD : ∀ y, V (D y) = y) :
    W - Z.comp (M.comp Y) = V

name: Singularity.local_transfer_error_bound
statement:
theorem local_transfer_error_bound {ι : Type*} (N : ℕ)
    (T : ℕ → (ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ)) (S : ℕ → Set ι) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (G P : ι → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hG : ∀ z, 0 ≤ G z)
    (hε : ∀ n < N, 0 ≤ ε n) (hsum : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ε n ≤ 1)
    (hmono : ∀ n < N, ∀ f g : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ z ∈ S (n + 1), f z ≤ g z) → ∀ z ∈ S n, T n f z ≤ T n g z)
    (hP : ∀ n < N, ∀ z ∈ S n, T n P z ≤ P z)
    (herror : ∀ n < N, ∀ z ∈ S n, G z - T n G z ≤ ε n * G z)
    (hterminal : ∀ z ∈ S N, G z ≤ C * P z) :
    ∀ z ∈ S 0, (1 - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ε n) * G z ≤ C * P z

name: Singularity.local_transfer_half_error_bound

    (T : ℕ → (ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ)) (S : ℕ → Set ι) (ε : ℕ → ℝ)
    (G P : ι → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hG : ∀ z, 0 ≤ G z)
    (hε : ∀ n < N, 0 ≤ ε n) (hsum : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ε n ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hmono : ∀ n < N, ∀ f g : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ z ∈ S (n + 1), f z ≤ g z) → ∀ z ∈ S n, T n f z ≤ T n g z)
    (hP : ∀ n < N, ∀ z ∈ S n, T n P z ≤ P z)
    (herror : ∀ n < N, ∀ z ∈ S n, G z - T n G z ≤ ε n * G z)
    (hterminal : ∀ z ∈ S N, G z ≤ C * P z) :
    ∀ z ∈ S 0, G z ≤ 2 * C * P z

name: Singularity.axisIntervalStep_nonneg
statement:
theorem axisIntervalStep_nonneg (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ p.1) (hr : 0 ≤ p.2) :
    0 ≤ (axisIntervalStep p).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (axisIntervalStep p).2

name: Singularity.axisInterval_length_le
statement:
theorem axisInterval_length_le (l r : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) :
    (axisInterval l r n).1 + (axisInterval l r n).2 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ)^n * (l + r)

name: Singularity.axisInterval_nonneg
statement:
theorem axisInterval_nonneg (l r : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (axisInterval l r n).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (axisInterval l r n).2

name: Singularity.axisInterval_radius_schedule
statement:
theorem axisInterval_radius_schedule (l r T R δ : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hR : 400 * R ≤ T) (hδ : 1600 * δ ≤ T) (N : ℕ)
    (hbefore : ∀ n < N, T < (axisInterval l r n).1 + (axisInterval l r n).2) :
    ∀ n < N, R + (N - 1 - n : ℕ) * δ ≤
      ((axisInterval l r n).1 + (axisInterval l r n).2) / 400

name: Singularity.exists_axisInterval_stop
statement:
theorem exists_axisInterval_stop (l r T : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, (axisInterval l r N).1 + (axisInterval l r N).2 ≤ T ∧
      ∀ n < N, T < (axisInterval l r n).1 + (axisInterval l r n).2

name: Singularity.axisPairSet_step
statement:
theorem axisPairSet_step (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (E : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ p.1) (_hr : 0 ≤ p.2) (u a : Γ)
    (hu : dist (u • UpperHalfPlane.I)
      (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I (axisIntervalCut p)) ≤ E)
    (ha : dist (a • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) < (p.1 + p.2) / 400)
    (xy : Γ × Γ) (hxy : xy ∈ axisPairSet Γ g E p) :
    (if axisIntervalLast p then (xy.1, a) else (a, xy.2)) ∈
      axisPairSet Γ g E (axisIntervalStep p)

name: Singularity.axisPairSet_step_geometry
statement:
theorem axisPairSet_step_geometry (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ p.1) (hr : 0 ≤ p.2)
    (hlarge : 400 * (E + Real.log 64 + 1) ≤ p.1 + p.2) (u : Γ)
    (hu : dist (u • UpperHalfPlane.I)
      (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I (axisIntervalCut p)) ≤ E)
    (xy : Γ × Γ) (hxy : xy ∈ axisPairSet Γ g E p) :
    2 ≤ dist (xy.1 • UpperHalfPlane.I) (xy.2 • UpperHalfPlane.I) ∧
    dist (xy.1 • UpperHalfPlane.I) (xy.2 • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 800 * ((p.1 + p.2) / 400) ∧
    dist (xy.1 • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) +
      dist (xy.2 • UpperHalfPlane.I) (u • UpperHalfPlane.I) -
      dist (xy.1 • UpperHalfPlane.I) (xy.2 • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 2 * Real.log 32 + 2 * E

name: Singularity.axisPairSet_terminal
statement:
theorem axisPairSet_terminal (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (E T : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ p.1) (hr : 0 ≤ p.2) (hsmall : p.1 + p.2 ≤ T)
    (o : Γ) (ho : dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) (o • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ E)
    (xy : Γ × Γ) (hxy : xy ∈ axisPairSet Γ g E p) :
    dist (xy.1 • UpperHalfPlane.I) (o • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 2 * T + 2 * E

name: Singularity.axisRadialCoordinate_dilation

theorem halfPlaneCayley_dist_neg_one_le (z : ℍ) :

name: Singularity.radial_opposite_cayley_separation
statement:
theorem radial_opposite_cayley_separation (z w : ℍ)
    (hz : axisRadialCoordinate z ≤ -Real.log 4)

name: Singularity.radial_opposite_triangle_excess
statement:
theorem radial_opposite_triangle_excess (z w : ℍ)
    (hz : axisRadialCoordinate z ≤ -Real.log 4)
    (hw : Real.log 4 ≤ axisRadialCoordinate w) :
    dist z UpperHalfPlane.I + dist w UpperHalfPlane.I - dist z w ≤ 2*Real.log 4

name: Singularity.radial_opposite_triangle_excess_at_axis
statement:
theorem radial_opposite_triangle_excess_at_axis (z w : ℍ) (t : ℝ)
    (hz : axisRadialCoordinate z ≤ t-Real.log 4)
    (hw : t+Real.log 4 ≤ axisRadialCoordinate w) :
    dist z (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) + dist w (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) -
      dist z w ≤ 2*Real.log 4

name: Singularity.radial_opposite_triangle_excess_near_axis
statement:
theorem radial_opposite_triangle_excess_near_axis (z w o : ℍ) (t E : ℝ)
    (hz : axisRadialCoordinate z ≤ t-Real.log 4)
    (hw : t+Real.log 4 ≤ axisRadialCoordinate w)
    (ho : dist o (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t) ≤ E) :
    dist z o + dist w o - dist z w ≤ 2*Real.log 4+2*E

name: Singularity.constant_of_eventual_oscillation_comparison
statement:
theorem constant_of_eventual_oscillation_comparison {X : Type*} [Nonempty X]
    (r : X → ℝ) (y : ℕ → X) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbelow : BddBelow (range r)) (habove : BddAbove (range r))
    (hlower : ∀ x, ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      c * (r (y n) - sInf (range r)) ≤ r x - sInf (range r))
    (hupper : ∀ x, ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      c * (sSup (range r) - r (y n)) ≤ sSup (range r) - r x) :
    ∀ x z, r x = r z

name: Singularity.supportedCoordinates_limit_exists
statement:
theorem supportedCoordinates_limit_exists {A : Set X} (e : ι ≃ A)
    {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} [l.NeBot] {u : α → supportedL2 A}
    {v : ι → ℂ} {b : ι → ℝ} (hb : Summable (fun i => b i ^ 2))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ n in l, ∀ i, ‖(u n : GroupL2 X) (e i)‖ ≤ b i)
    (hpoint : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => (u n : GroupL2 X) (e i)) l (𝓝 (v i))) :
    ∃ w : supportedL2 A, (∀ i, (w : GroupL2 X) (e i) = v i) ∧ Tendsto u l (𝓝 w)

name: Singularity.cocompactRaySequence_triangle_excess
statement:
theorem cocompactRaySequence_triangle_excess (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    [CompactSpace (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel Γ ℍ))] (ξ : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    dist UpperHalfPlane.I (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ m • UpperHalfPlane.I) +
      dist (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ n • UpperHalfPlane.I) (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ m • UpperHalfPlane.I) -
      dist UpperHalfPlane.I (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ n • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 4 * cocompactOrbitRadius Γ

name: Singularity.cayley_separated_tails

    (hx : Tendsto (fun n => halfPlaneCayley (x n)) atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hy : Tendsto (fun n => halfPlaneCayley (y n)) atTop (𝓝 b)) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N,
      δ ≤ dist (halfPlaneCayley (x m)) (halfPlaneCayley (y n))

name: Singularity.cocompactRaySequence_eventual_triangle_excess
statement:
theorem cocompactRaySequence_eventual_triangle_excess (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    [CompactSpace (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel Γ ℍ))] (ξ : ℝ) (x : Γ) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ m, n ≤ m →
      dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ n • UpperHalfPlane.I) +
      dist (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ m • UpperHalfPlane.I)
        (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ n • UpperHalfPlane.I) -
      dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (cocompactRaySequence Γ ξ m • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤
        1 + 4 * cocompactOrbitRadius Γ

    (r : ℕ → X) (hr : ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → dist (r m) (r n) = (n : ℝ) - m)
    (x : X) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ m, n ≤ m →
      dist x (r n) + dist (r m) (r n) - dist x (r m) ≤ 1

name: Singularity.logDensity_bound_of_shadow_return_cover
statement:
theorem logDensity_bound_of_shadow_return_cover {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MeasurableSpace B] [MulAction Γ B] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ B]
    (ν m : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m] (hac : ν ≪ m)
    (hν : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (hm : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) m ≪ m)
    (g : ℕ → Γ) (Sν Sm : ℕ → Set B) (Dν Dm : ℕ → ℝ)
    (F : Finset Γ) (Cν Cm L M J : ℝ)
    (hνshadow : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ n, ξ ∈ Sν n → |stationaryLogCocycle ν (g n) ξ - Dν n| ≤ Cν)
    (hmshadow : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ n, ξ ∈ Sm n → |stationaryLogCocycle m (g n) ξ - Dm n| ≤ Cm)
    (hmag : ∀ n, |Dν n - Dm n| ≤ L)
    (hcorrection : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ F,
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν a ξ - stationaryLogCocycle m a ξ| ≤ J)
    (hcover : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ n : ℕ,
      a⁻¹ • ξ ∈ Sν n ∩ Sm n ∧
      |Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv m (g n • (a⁻¹ • ξ))).toReal)| ≤ M) :
    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, |Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv m ξ).toReal)| ≤ M + Cν + Cm + L + J

name: Singularity.exp_neg_stationaryLogCocycle

name: Singularity.measure_smul_image_bounds_of_logCocycle
statement:
theorem measure_smul_image_bounds_of_logCocycle (g : Γ) {E : Set B}
    (hE : MeasurableSet E) (D C : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ξ ∈ E → |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D - C)) * ν E ≤ ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) '' E) ∧
      ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) '' E) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D + C)) * ν E

name: Singularity.shadow_mass_bounds_of_logCocycle
statement:
theorem shadow_mass_bounds_of_logCocycle (g : Γ) {S : Set B}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (D C : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ξ ∈ (fun η : B => g • η) ⁻¹' S →
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D - C)) * ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' S) ≤ ν S ∧
      ν S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D + C)) * ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' S)

name: Singularity.mixed_shadow_mass_bounds_of_logCocycle
statement:
theorem mixed_shadow_mass_bounds_of_logCocycle (g : Γ) {S T : Set B}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) (D C : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ξ ∈ (fun η : B => g • η) ⁻¹' S →
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C)
    (a b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (ha : ν (((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' S)ᶜ) ≤ a)
    (hb : ν (((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' T)ᶜ) ≤ b) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D - C)) * (1 - (a + b)) ≤ ν (S ∩ T) ∧
      ν (S ∩ T) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D + C))

name: Singularity.mixed_shadow_mass_bounds_of_quarter_complements
statement:
theorem mixed_shadow_mass_bounds_of_quarter_complements (g : Γ) {S T : Set B}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) (D C : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ξ ∈ (fun η : B => g • η) ⁻¹' S →
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C)
    (ha : ν (((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' S)ᶜ) ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hb : ν (((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' T)ᶜ) ≤ 1 / 4) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D - C)) / 2 ≤ ν (S ∩ T) ∧
      ν (S ∩ T) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D + C))

name: Singularity.probability_inter_lower_of_compl_bounds

name: Singularity.shadow_magnitude_comparison
statement:
theorem shadow_magnitude_comparison {B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B]
    (ν m : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m] (S : Set B)
    (Dν Dm Cν Cm K : ℝ)
    (hνl : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν - Cν)) ≤ ν S)
    (hνu : ν S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν + Cν)))
    (hml : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm - Cm)) ≤ m S)
    (hmu : m S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm + Cm)))
    (hl : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-K)) • m ≤ ν)
    (hu : ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp K) • m) :
    |Dν - Dm| ≤ Cν + Cm + K

name: Singularity.shadow_magnitude_upper_of_one_sided_comparison
statement:
theorem shadow_magnitude_upper_of_one_sided_comparison {B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B]
    (ν m : Measure B) (S : Set B) (Dν Dm C K a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hml : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm)) * ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ m S)
    (hνu : ν S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (C - Dν)))

    Dν ≤ Dm + K + C - Real.log a

name: Singularity.magnitude_rigidity_of_bounded_sequence_return_cover
statement:
theorem magnitude_rigidity_of_bounded_sequence_return_cover {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MeasurableSpace B] [MulAction Γ B] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ B]
    (ν m : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m]
    (hac : ν ≪ m) (hreverse : m ≪ ν)
    (hν : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (hm : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) m ≪ m)
    (S : Γ → Set B) (Dν Dm : Γ → ℝ) (Cν Cm : ℝ)
    (hνl : ∀ a, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν a - Cν)) ≤ ν (S a))
    (hνu : ∀ a, ν (S a) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν a + Cν)))
    (hml : ∀ a, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm a - Cm)) ≤ m (S a))
    (hmu : ∀ a, m (S a) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm a + Cm)))
    (hνshadow : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a : Γ, a • ξ ∈ S a →
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν a ξ - Dν a| ≤ Cν)
    (hmshadow : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a : Γ, a • ξ ∈ S a →
      |stationaryLogCocycle m a ξ - Dm a| ≤ Cm)
    (g : ℕ → Γ) (L : ℝ) (hL : ∀ n, |Dν (g n) - Dm (g n)| ≤ L)
    (F : Finset Γ) (M J : ℝ)
    (hcorrection : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ F,
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν a ξ - stationaryLogCocycle m a ξ| ≤ J)
    (hcover : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ n : ℕ,
      g n • (a⁻¹ • ξ) ∈ S (g n) ∧
      |Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv m (g n • (a⁻¹ • ξ))).toReal)| ≤ M) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Γ, |Dν a - Dm a| ≤ C

    (ns : ℕ → ℕ) (hns : Tendsto ns atTop atTop) (c : ℝ)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun k => birkhoffAverage ℝ T f (ns k) x) atTop (𝓝 c)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(α'.prod β').map chart,
      Tendsto (fun k => birkhoffAverage ℝ T f (ns k) x) atTop (𝓝 c)

name: Singularity.stable_charts_birkhoffAverage_transfer
statement:
theorem stable_charts_birkhoffAverage_transfer {X A B I : Type*} [Countable I]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B]
    (T : X → X) (hT : Measurable T) (f : X → ℝ)
    (hf : UniformContinuous f) (μ ν : Measure X)
    (α α' : I → Measure A) (β β' : I → Measure B)
    [∀ i, NeZero (α i)] [∀ i, SFinite (β i)] [∀ i, SFinite (β' i)]
    (hβ : ∀ i, β' i ≪ β i)
    (chart : I → A × B → X) (hchart : ∀ i, Measurable (chart i))
    (href : ∀ i, ((α i).prod (β i)).map (chart i) ≪ μ)
    (hcover : ν ≪ Measure.sum (fun i => ((α' i).prod (β' i)).map (chart i)))
    (hstable : ∀ i a a' b, Tendsto
      (fun n => dist (T^[n] (chart i (a, b))) (T^[n] (chart i (a', b)))) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (ns : ℕ → ℕ) (hns : Tendsto ns atTop atTop) (c : ℝ)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun k => birkhoffAverage ℝ T f (ns k) x) atTop (𝓝 c)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, Tendsto (fun k => birkhoffAverage ℝ T f (ns k) x) atTop (𝓝 c)

name: Singularity.cocompact_invariant_probability_eq_haar_of_horocycle_charts
statement:
theorem cocompact_invariant_probability_eq_haar_of_horocycle_charts
    {B I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B] [Countable I]
    [MeasurableSpace SL(2, ℝ)] [BorelSpace SL(2, ℝ)]
    (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology Γ]
    [CompactSpace (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel Γ ℍ))]
    (ν : Measure SL(2, ℝ)) [IsHaarMeasure ν]
    (m : Measure (SL(2, ℝ) ⧸ Γ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hinv : MeasurePreserving (fun x : SL(2, ℝ) ⧸ Γ => dilationMatrix τ • x) m m)
    (α α' : I → Measure ℝ) (β β' : I → Measure B)
    [∀ i, NeZero (α i)] [∀ i, SFinite (β i)] [∀ i, SFinite (β' i)]
    (hβ : ∀ i, β' i ≪ β i)
    (σ : I → B → SL(2, ℝ) ⧸ Γ) (hσ : ∀ i, Measurable (σ i))
    (href : ∀ i, ((α i).prod (β i)).map (lowerShearQuotientChart Γ (σ i)) ≪
      cocompactHaarQuotientProbability Γ ν)
    (hcover : m ≪ Measure.sum (fun i =>
      ((α' i).prod (β' i)).map (lowerShearQuotientChart Γ (σ i)))) :
    m = cocompactHaarQuotientProbability Γ ν

name: Singularity.cocompact_invariant_probability_eq_haar_of_stable_charts
statement:
theorem cocompact_invariant_probability_eq_haar_of_stable_charts
    {A B I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B] [Countable I]
    [MeasurableSpace SL(2, ℝ)] [BorelSpace SL(2, ℝ)]
    (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology Γ]

    (ν : Measure SL(2, ℝ)) [IsHaarMeasure ν]
    (m : Measure (SL(2, ℝ) ⧸ Γ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure m]
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hinv : MeasurePreserving (fun x : SL(2, ℝ) ⧸ Γ => dilationMatrix τ • x) m m)
    (α α' : I → Measure A) (β β' : I → Measure B)
    [∀ i, NeZero (α i)] [∀ i, SFinite (β i)] [∀ i, SFinite (β' i)]
    (hβ : ∀ i, β' i ≪ β i)
    (Φ : I → A × B → SL(2, ℝ) ⧸ Γ) (hΦ : ∀ i, Measurable (Φ i))
    (href : ∀ i, ((α i).prod (β i)).map (Φ i) ≪
      cocompactHaarQuotientProbability Γ ν)
    (hcover : m ≪ Measure.sum (fun i =>
      ((α' i).prod (β' i)).map (Φ i)))
    (hfibre : ∀ i a a' b, ∃ u : ℝ, Φ i (a', b) = lowerShearMatrix u • Φ i (a, b)) :
    m = cocompactHaarQuotientProbability Γ ν

    (D : Γ → ℝ) (g : Γ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)

statement:
theorem commonSubtraction_base {X : Type*} (k : ℕ → X → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (o : X) (f : X → ℝ)
    (hk : ∀ n, k n o = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    commonSubtraction k c o f n o = (1-c)^n * f o

name: Singularity.commonSubtraction_contraction
statement:
theorem commonSubtraction_contraction {X : Type*} (k : ℕ → X → ℝ) (c ε : ℝ) (o : X)
    (f g : X → ℝ) (S : ℕ → Set X) (N : ℕ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hk : ∀ n, k n o = 1) (hfg : f o = g o)
    (hS : ∀ n < N, S (n+1) ⊆ S n) (hf : ∀ x ∈ S 0, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x ∈ S 0, 0 ≤ g x)
    (hremove : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g} : Set (X → ℝ)), ∀ n < N, ∀ x ∈ S (n+1),
      ε * commonSubtraction k c o u n x ≤ c * commonSubtraction k c o u n o * k n x ∧
      c * commonSubtraction k c o u n o * k n x ≤ commonSubtraction k c o u n x) :
    ∀ x ∈ S N, |f x - g x| ≤ (1-ε)^N * (f x + g x)

name: Singularity.commonSubtraction_difference
statement:
theorem commonSubtraction_difference {X : Type*} (k : ℕ → X → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (o : X) (f g : X → ℝ)
    (hk : ∀ n, k n o = 1) (hfg : f o = g o) (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    commonSubtraction k c o f n x - commonSubtraction k c o g n x = f x - g x

name: Singularity.commonSubtraction_geometric_bound

    (f : X → ℝ) (S : ℕ → Set X) (N : ℕ) (_hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hS : ∀ n < N, S (n+1) ⊆ S n) (hf : ∀ x ∈ S 0, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hremove : ∀ n < N, ∀ x ∈ S (n+1),
      ε * commonSubtraction k c o f n x ≤ c * commonSubtraction k c o f n o * k n x ∧
      c * commonSubtraction k c o f n o * k n x ≤ commonSubtraction k c o f n x) :
    ∀ n ≤ N, ∀ x ∈ S n, 0 ≤ commonSubtraction k c o f n x ∧
      commonSubtraction k c o f n x ≤ (1-ε)^n * f x

theorem harmonic_minimal_martinTranslate {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]

    (hfh : ∀ x, ∑ a ∈ s, μ a * f (x * a) = f x) :

name: Singularity.aemeasurable_walkPathLimit
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_walkPathLimit (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (orbit : Γ → B)
    (hconv : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      ∃ ξ : B, Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds ξ)) :
    AEMeasurable (walkPathLimit s orbit) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.exists_measurable_walkLimit
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_walkLimit (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (orbit : Γ → B)
    (hconv : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      ∃ ξ : B, Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds ξ)) :
    ∃ b : (ℕ → s) → B, Measurable b ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
        Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (b ω))

name: Singularity.exists_stationary_walkLimit
statement:
theorem exists_stationary_walkLimit (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (orbit : Γ → B) (horbit : ∀ g h, orbit (g * h) = g • orbit h)
    (hconv : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ (fun g hg => (hpos g hg).le) hmass,
      ∃ ξ : B, Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds ξ)) :
    ∃ b : (ℕ → s) → B, Measurable b ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ (fun g hg => (hpos g hg).le) hmass,
        Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (b ω))) ∧
      let ν := walkBoundaryLaw s μ (fun g hg => (hpos g hg).le) hmass b
      IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      ν = (∑ g : s, ENNReal.ofReal (μ g) • Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (g : Γ) • ξ) ν) ∧
      ∀ g : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν ≪ ν ∧
        ν ≪ Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLaw_unique
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLaw_unique (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (orbit : Γ → B)
    (b c : (ℕ → s) → B)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (b ω)))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (c ω))) :
    walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b = walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass c

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLimit_ae_unique
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLimit_ae_unique (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (orbit : Γ → B)
    (b c : (ℕ → s) → B)

      Tendsto (fun n => orbit (walkPosition s 1 n ω)) atTop (nhds (b ω)))

name: Singularity.eventually_bounded_magnitude_difference_of_concentration
statement:
theorem eventually_bounded_magnitude_difference_of_concentration
    {B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B] (ν m : Measure B)
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m] {E : Set B} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (S : ℕ → Set B) (Dν Dm : ℕ → ℝ) (Cν Cm M : ℝ)
    (hl : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-M)) • m.restrict E ≤ ν.restrict E)
    (hu : ν.restrict E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp M) • m.restrict E)
    (hνl : ∀ n, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν n - Cν)) ≤ ν (S n))
    (hνu : ∀ n, ν (S n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν n + Cν)))
    (hml : ∀ n, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm n - Cm)) ≤ m (S n))
    (hmu : ∀ n, m (S n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm n + Cm)))
    (hνcon : Tendsto (fun n => (ν (S n \ E)).toReal / (ν (S n)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hmcon : Tendsto (fun n => (m (S n \ E)).toReal / (m (S n)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |Dν n - Dm n| ≤ Cν + Cm + M + Real.log 2

name: Singularity.log_shadow_mass_difference_of_window_concentration
statement:
theorem log_shadow_mass_difference_of_window_concentration
    {B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B] (ν m : Measure B)
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m] {S E : Set B} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (M : ℝ)
    (hl : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-M)) • m.restrict E ≤ ν.restrict E)
    (hu : ν.restrict E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp M) • m.restrict E)
    (hpν : 0 < (ν S).toReal) (hpm : 0 < (m S).toReal)
    (hνerr : (ν (S \ E)).toReal / (ν S).toReal ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hmerr : (m (S \ E)).toReal / (m S).toReal ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |Real.log (ν S).toReal - Real.log (m S).toReal| ≤ M + Real.log 2

name: Singularity.measureReal_le_twice_inter_of_relative_error

    (ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' (S \ E))).toReal ≤

name: Singularity.shadow_return_cover_of_adjustable_family
statement:
theorem shadow_return_cover_of_adjustable_family
    {Γ B I : Type*} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ] [MeasurableSpace B]
    [TopologicalSpace B] [CompactSpace B] [RegularSpace B]
    [MulAction Γ B] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ B] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ B]
    (ν : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hq : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (g : ℕ → Γ) (S : I → ℕ → Set B) {E Z : Set B}
    (hS : ∀ i n, MeasurableSet (S i n)) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hpos : ∀ i n, 0 < ν (S i n)) (D : ℕ → ℝ) (C : I → ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ i n, ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, g n • ξ ∈ S i n →
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν (g n) ξ - D n| ≤ C i)
    (hratio : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => (ν (S i n \ E)).toReal / (ν (S i n)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hescape : ∀ ξ : B, ∃ a : Γ, a⁻¹ • ξ ∉ Z)
    (hshrink : ∀ U : Set B, IsOpen U → Z ⊆ U → ∃ i : I,
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ((fun ξ : B => g n • ξ) ⁻¹' S i n)ᶜ ⊆ U) :
    ∃ i : I, ∃ F : Finset Γ, ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ n : ℕ,

    (g : ℕ → Γ) (S : ℕ → Set B) {E Z : Set B}
    (hS : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (S n)) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < ν (S n)) (D : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ)

    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => k p.1 * inner ℂ (h p.2) (f (p.2 - p.1)))
      (volume.prod volume)

name: Singularity.integral_norm_inner_translation_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_inner_translation_le (u : ℝ) (h f : RealLineL2) :
