name: Singularity.integral_norm_mul_norm_L2
statement:
theorem integral_norm_mul_norm_L2 (f g : RealLineL2) :
    ∫ t, ‖f t‖ * ‖g t‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖g‖

name: Singularity.counting_adjoint_coefficient
statement:
theorem counting_adjoint_coefficient (T : GroupL2 X →L[ℂ] GroupL2 X) (x y : X) :
    T.adjoint (countingDelta x) y = (starRingEnd ℂ) (T (countingDelta y) x)

name: Singularity.counting_inner_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem counting_inner_eq_tsum (f g : GroupL2 X) :
    inner ℂ f g = ∑' x, inner ℂ (f x) (g x)

name: Singularity.counting_inner_summable
statement:
theorem counting_inner_summable (f g : GroupL2 X) :
    Summable (fun x => inner ℂ (f x) (g x))

name: Singularity.counting_operator_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem counting_operator_eq_tsum (T : GroupL2 X →L[ℂ] GroupL2 X) (f : GroupL2 X) (x : X) :
    T f x = ∑' y, T (countingDelta y) x * f y

name: Singularity.counting_operator_kernel_summable
statement:
theorem counting_operator_kernel_summable (T : GroupL2 X →L[ℂ] GroupL2 X) (f : GroupL2 X) (x : X) :

name: Singularity.supportedRestriction_delta_mem
statement:
theorem supportedRestriction_delta_mem (A : Set X) (a : A) :

name: Singularity.supportedRestriction_delta_notMem

name: Singularity.firstEntranceKernel_eq_zero_of_notMem

name: Singularity.killedGreen_target_mem

name: Singularity.counting_inner_eq_of_eq_off_boundary
statement:
theorem counting_inner_eq_of_eq_off_boundary (A : Set X) (u v w : GroupL2 X)
    (hu : ∀ x ∈ A, u x = 0) (hvw : ∀ x, x ∉ A → v x = w x) :

name: Singularity.killed_columns_duality
statement:
theorem killed_columns_duality (P : GroupL2 X →L[ℂ] GroupL2 X) (A : Set X)
    (f h : GroupL2 X) (x y : X)
    (hfA : ∀ z ∈ A, f z = 0) (hhA : ∀ z ∈ A, h z = 0)
    (hf : ∀ z, z ∉ A → (f-P f) z = countingDelta y z)
    (hh : ∀ z, z ∉ A → (h-P.adjoint h) z = countingDelta x z) :
    f x = (starRingEnd ℂ) (h y)

name: Singularity.rightMarkov_delta_predecessors
statement:
theorem rightMarkov_delta_predecessors (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (a : Γ) :
    rightMarkov s μ (countingDelta a) =
      ∑ g ∈ s, (μ g : ℂ) • countingDelta (a * g⁻¹)

name: Singularity.boundaryExitFlux_eq_zero_of_notMem

name: Singularity.boundaryExitFlux_nonneg

name: Singularity.bounded_coordinate_layer_separates
statement:
theorem bounded_coordinate_layer_separates (s : Finset Γ) (h : Γ → ℝ) (L t : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hjump : ∀ x : Γ, ∀ g ∈ s, |h (x*g) - h x| ≤ L)
    (D : Set Γ) (hcover : ∀ x, t ≤ h x → h x ≤ t + L → x ∈ D)
    (x y : Γ) (hx : t + L < h x) (hy : h y < t) :
    SeparatesJumpPaths s D x y

name: Singularity.killedWeight_eq_transition_of_short_excursion
statement:
theorem killedWeight_eq_transition_of_short_excursion
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (h : Γ → ℝ) (L r : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ x : Γ, ∀ g ∈ s, |h (x*g) - h x| ≤ L)
    (A : Set Γ) (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, h a ≤ r) (n : ℕ) (x y : Γ)
    (hshort : (n : ℝ) * L < h x + h y - 2*r) :
    killedWeight s μ A n x y = transitionWeight s μ n x y

name: Singularity.walkEndpoint_coordinate_bound
statement:
theorem walkEndpoint_coordinate_bound (s : Finset Γ) (h : Γ → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ x : Γ, ∀ g ∈ s, |h (x*g) - h x| ≤ L)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Γ) (w : WalkWord s n) :
    |h (walkEndpoint s n x w) - h x| ≤ (n : ℝ) * L

name: Singularity.walk_avoids_sublevel_of_short_excursion
statement:
theorem walk_avoids_sublevel_of_short_excursion (s : Finset Γ) (h : Γ → ℝ) (L r : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ x : Γ, ∀ g ∈ s, |h (x*g) - h x| ≤ L)
    (A : Set Γ) (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, h a ≤ r) (n : ℕ) (x : Γ) (w : WalkWord s n)
    (hshort : (n : ℝ) * L < h x + h (walkEndpoint s n x w) - 2*r) :
    avoidsBefore s A n x w ∧ walkEndpoint s n x w ∉ A

theorem axisRadialCoordinate_ge_iff_normSq (z : ℍ) (r : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem axisRadialCoordinate_segment_lower (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (r a b t : ℝ)

    (ha : r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I a))
    (hb : r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I b)) :
    r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t)

name: Singularity.axis_mobius_normSq
statement:
theorem axis_mobius_normSq (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq ((g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t : ℍ) : ℂ) =
      ((g 0 0)^2 * (Real.exp t)^2 + (g 0 1)^2) /
        ((g 1 0)^2 * (Real.exp t)^2 + (g 1 1)^2)

theorem axis_mobius_radius_denominator_pos (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (t : ℝ) :

statement:

    Complex.normSq ((u : ℂ) * (verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I t : ℂ) + (v : ℂ)) =

name: Singularity.exists_radially_deep_geodesic_line
statement:
theorem exists_radially_deep_geodesic_line (q : SL(2, ℝ)) (z w : ℍ) (r : ℝ)
    (hz : r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • z)) (hw : r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • w)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ → ℍ, Isometry c ∧ c 0 = z ∧ c (dist z w) = w ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 (dist z w), r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • c t)

name: Singularity.deep_radial_orbit_chain_of_cover
statement:
theorem deep_radial_orbit_chain_of_cover (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hcover : ∀ z : ℍ, ∃ g : Γ, dist (g • UpperHalfPlane.I) z ≤ E)
    (q : SL(2, ℝ)) (r : ℝ) (x y : Γ)
    (hx : r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (x • UpperHalfPlane.I)))
    (hy : r ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (y • UpperHalfPlane.I))) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Γ), f 0 = x ∧ f N = y ∧
      (N : ℝ) ≤ dist (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) (y • UpperHalfPlane.I)+4 ∧
      (∀ k < N, dist (f k • UpperHalfPlane.I) (f (k+1) • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ 2*E+1) ∧
      ∀ k ≤ N, r-E ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (f k • UpperHalfPlane.I))

    (hdistinct : Function.Injective (fun z : Bool × Bool => if z.2 then p z.1 else q z.1))
    (hdyn : ∀ i, UniformNorthSouth (a i) (p i) (q i)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift (fun i => a i ^ n))

name: Singularity.compactBoundary_dilation_coe
statement:
theorem compactBoundary_dilation_coe (t x : ℝ) :
    dilationMatrix t • (x : OnePoint ℝ) = (Real.exp t * x : ℝ)

name: Singularity.compactBoundary_dilation_infty
statement:
theorem compactBoundary_dilation_infty (t : ℝ) :
    dilationMatrix t • (∞ : OnePoint ℝ) = ∞

name: Singularity.compactBoundary_nhds_infty_bound
statement:
theorem compactBoundary_nhds_infty_bound (U : Set (OnePoint ℝ)) (hU : U ∈ nhds ∞) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∞ ∈ U ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, R < |x| → (x : OnePoint ℝ) ∈ U

name: Singularity.compactBoundary_nhds_zero_bound
statement:
theorem compactBoundary_nhds_zero_bound (V : Set (OnePoint ℝ))
    (hV : V ∈ nhds ((0 : ℝ) : OnePoint ℝ)) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, |x| < ε → (x : OnePoint ℝ) ∈ V

name: Singularity.dilationMatrix_northSouth
statement:
theorem dilationMatrix_northSouth {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    UniformNorthSouth (dilationMatrix t) (∞ : OnePoint ℝ) ((0 : ℝ) : OnePoint ℝ)

name: Singularity.slTwo_fixes_I_iff
statement:
theorem slTwo_fixes_I_iff (g : SL(2, ℝ)) :
    g • UpperHalfPlane.I = UpperHalfPlane.I ↔
      g 0 0 = g 1 1 ∧ g 0 1 = -g 1 0

name: Singularity.slTwo_fixes_I_of_commutator_trace_le
statement:
theorem slTwo_fixes_I_of_commutator_trace_le (a g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (hfix : a • UpperHalfPlane.I = UpperHalfPlane.I) (hc : a 1 0 ≠ 0)
    (htrace : (a * g * a⁻¹ * g⁻¹) 0 0 + (a * g * a⁻¹ * g⁻¹) 1 1 ≤ 2) :
    g • UpperHalfPlane.I = UpperHalfPlane.I

name: Singularity.slTwo_parabolic_commutator_trace
statement:
theorem slTwo_parabolic_commutator_trace (a g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (ha : a 0 0 = a 1 1) (hc : a 1 0 = 0) :
    (a * g * a⁻¹ * g⁻¹) 0 0 + (a * g * a⁻¹ * g⁻¹) 1 1 =
      2 + (a 0 1) ^ 2 * (g 1 0) ^ 2

name: Singularity.slTwo_rotation_commutator_trace
statement:
theorem slTwo_rotation_commutator_trace (a g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (ha : a 0 0 = a 1 1) (hb : a 0 1 = -a 1 0) :
    (a * g * a⁻¹ * g⁻¹) 0 0 + (a * g * a⁻¹ * g⁻¹) 1 1 =
      2 + (a 1 0) ^ 2 * ((g 0 0 - g 1 1) ^ 2 + (g 0 1 + g 1 0) ^ 2)

name: Singularity.slTwo_trace_conjugate
statement:
theorem slTwo_trace_conjugate (g B : SL(2, ℝ)) :
    (B * g * B⁻¹) 0 0 + (B * g * B⁻¹) 1 1 = g 0 0 + g 1 1

name: Singularity.conjugateSubgroup_trace_bound
statement:
theorem conjugateSubgroup_trace_bound (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (B : SL(2, ℝ))
    (h : ∀ g : Γ, |(g : SL(2, ℝ)) 0 0 + (g : SL(2, ℝ)) 1 1| ≤ 2)
    (g : conjugateSubgroup Γ B) : |(g : SL(2, ℝ)) 0 0 + (g : SL(2, ℝ)) 1 1| ≤ 2

name: Singularity.exists_common_fixedPoint_of_elliptic
statement:
theorem exists_common_fixedPoint_of_elliptic (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    (hbound : ∀ g : Γ, |(g : SL(2, ℝ)) 0 0 + (g : SL(2, ℝ)) 1 1| ≤ 2)
    (a : Γ) (ha : |(a : SL(2, ℝ)) 0 0 + (a : SL(2, ℝ)) 1 1| < 2) :
    ∃ z : ℍ, ∀ g : Γ, g • z = z

name: Singularity.slTwo_exists_fixedPoint_of_abs_trace_lt_two
statement:
theorem slTwo_exists_fixedPoint_of_abs_trace_lt_two (g : SL(2, ℝ))

name: Singularity.slTwo_isElliptic_of_abs_trace_lt_two
statement:
theorem slTwo_isElliptic_of_abs_trace_lt_two (g : SL(2, ℝ))
    (h : |g 0 0 + g 1 1| < 2) : (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ g).IsElliptic

name: Singularity.uniform_shadow_mass_of_exceptional_subsequences
statement:
theorem uniform_shadow_mass_of_exceptional_subsequences
    {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B] [TopologicalSpace B]
    (ν : Measure B) [Measure.OuterRegular ν] [NullSingletonClass ν]
    (T : ℕ → A → Set B) (hmono : ∀ a, Monotone (fun N => T N a))
    (hcompact : ∀ g : ℕ → A, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ∃ Z : Set B, Z.Finite ∧ ∀ U : Set B, IsOpen U → Z ⊆ U →
        ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ξ ∉ T R (g (φ n)) → ξ ∈ U)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ a : A, ν ((T N a)ᶜ) < ε

name: Singularity.exists_finite_exit_enlargement
statement:
theorem exists_finite_exit_enlargement {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
    (s A : Finset Γ) (V : Set Γ)
    (hstep : ∀ v : Γ, v ∉ (A : Set Γ) → ∀ t ∈ s,
      v * t ∉ (A : Set Γ) → v ∈ V → v * t ∈ V) :
    ∃ T : Finset Γ, A ⊆ T ∧ ∀ v ∈ V, v ∉ (T : Set Γ) → ∀ t ∈ s, v * t ∈ V

name: Singularity.condExp_finite_independent
statement:
theorem condExp_finite_independent {Ω A B : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B]
    [Fintype A] [MeasurableSingletonClass A]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (X : Ω → A) (Y : Ω → B) (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hind : IndepFun X Y P) (f : A → B → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ a, Measurable (f a)) (hint : ∀ a, Integrable (fun ω => f a (Y ω)) P) :
    P[fun ω => f (X ω) (Y ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance] =ᵐ[P]
      fun ω => ∫ η, f (X ω) (Y η) ∂P

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_le_wordDistance_mul
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_le_wordDistance_mul (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) :
    ∃ L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ x y, jumpDistance s hgen x y ≤ L * wordDistance s hgen x y

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_reverse_word_bound
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_reverse_word_bound (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (hinv : ∀ g ∈ s, g⁻¹ ∈ s)
    (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) (x : Γ) :
    jumpDistance s hgen (walkEndpoint s n x w) x ≤ n

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_symm_of_inverse_closed
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_symm_of_inverse_closed (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (hinv : ∀ g ∈ s, g⁻¹ ∈ s)
    (x y : Γ) : jumpDistance s hgen x y = jumpDistance s hgen y x

name: Singularity.mem_symmetricWordSupport
statement:
theorem mem_symmetricWordSupport (s : Finset Γ) (g : Γ) :
    g ∈ symmetricWordSupport s ↔ g ∈ s ∨ g⁻¹ ∈ s

name: Singularity.symmetricWordSupport_generates
statement:
theorem symmetricWordSupport_generates (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) :
    Submonoid.closure (symmetricWordSupport s : Set Γ) = ⊤

name: Singularity.symmetricWordSupport_inverse_closed
statement:
theorem symmetricWordSupport_inverse_closed (s : Finset Γ) (g : Γ)
    (hg : g ∈ symmetricWordSupport s) : g⁻¹ ∈ symmetricWordSupport s

name: Singularity.wordDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem wordDistance_eq_zero_iff (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x y : Γ) : wordDistance s hgen x y = 0 ↔ x = y

name: Singularity.wordDistance_le_jumpDistance
statement:
theorem wordDistance_le_jumpDistance (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (x y : Γ) :
    wordDistance s hgen x y ≤ jumpDistance s hgen x y

name: Singularity.wordDistance_left
statement:
theorem wordDistance_left (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (g x y : Γ) : wordDistance s hgen (g * x) (g * y) = wordDistance s hgen x y

name: Singularity.wordDistance_symm
statement:
theorem wordDistance_symm (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x y : Γ) : wordDistance s hgen x y = wordDistance s hgen y x

name: Singularity.wordDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem wordDistance_triangle (s : Finset Γ) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤)
    (x y z : Γ) : wordDistance s hgen x z ≤ wordDistance s hgen x y + wordDistance s hgen y z

name: Singularity.freeGroup_cyclic_core_ne_nil
statement:
theorem freeGroup_cyclic_core_ne_nil (g : FreeGroup α) (hg : g ≠ 1) :
    FreeGroup.reduceCyclically g.toWord ≠ []

name: Singularity.freeGroup_norm_pow_ge
statement:
theorem freeGroup_norm_pow_ge (g : FreeGroup α) (hg : g ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    n ≤ FreeGroup.norm (g ^ n)

name: Singularity.freeGroup_norm_pow_succ
statement:
theorem freeGroup_norm_pow_succ (g : FreeGroup α) (n : ℕ) :
    FreeGroup.norm (g ^ (n + 1)) =
      2 * (FreeGroup.reduceCyclically.conjugator g.toWord).length +
        (n + 1) * (FreeGroup.reduceCyclically g.toWord).length

name: Singularity.schreierRepresentative_left
statement:
theorem schreierRepresentative_left (h : H) (x : G) :
    hR.toRightFun ((h : G) * x) = hR.toRightFun x

name: Singularity.schreierRepresentative_subgroup
statement:
theorem schreierRepresentative_subgroup (hR1 : (1 : G) ∈ R) (h : H) :
    hR.toRightFun (h : G) = ⟨1, hR1⟩

name: Singularity.schreierRetraction_jump_norm
statement:
theorem schreierRetraction_jump_norm (s : Finset G) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ g ∈ s, FreeGroup.norm (φ (schreierRetraction H R hR ((r : G) * g))) ≤ L)
    (x : G) {g : G} (hg : g ∈ s) :
    FreeGroup.norm (φ (schreierRetraction H R hR (x * g))) ≤
      FreeGroup.norm (φ (schreierRetraction H R hR x)) + L

name: Singularity.schreierRetraction_mul
statement:
theorem schreierRetraction_mul (x g : G) :
    schreierRetraction H R hR (x * g) = schreierRetraction H R hR x *
      schreierRetraction H R hR ((hR.toRightFun x : G) * g)

name: Singularity.schreierRetraction_subgroup
statement:
theorem schreierRetraction_subgroup (hR1 : (1 : G) ∈ R) (h : H) :
    schreierRetraction H R hR (h : G) = h

name: Singularity.schreierRetraction_word_norm
statement:
theorem schreierRetraction_word_norm (s : Finset G) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ g ∈ s, FreeGroup.norm (φ (schreierRetraction H R hR ((r : G) * g))) ≤ L)
    (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) (x : G) :
    FreeGroup.norm (φ (schreierRetraction H R hR (walkEndpoint s n x w))) ≤
      FreeGroup.norm (φ (schreierRetraction H R hR x)) + L * n

name: Singularity.exists_power_linear_word_growth_of_finiteIndex_free
statement:
theorem exists_power_linear_word_growth_of_finiteIndex_free (H : Subgroup G)
    [H.FiniteIndex] [IsFreeGroup H]
    (s : Finset G) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set G) = ⊤)
    (g : G) (hg : ¬IsOfFinOrder g) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
      κ * n ≤ (wordDistance s hgen 1 ((g ^ m) ^ n) : ℝ)

name: Singularity.finiteIndex_free_norm_word_bound
statement:
theorem finiteIndex_free_norm_word_bound (H : Subgroup G) [H.FiniteIndex]
    (φ : H →* FreeGroup α) (s : Finset G) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set G) = ⊤) :
    ∃ L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ h : H, FreeGroup.norm (φ h) ≤ L * wordDistance s hgen 1 (h : G)

name: Singularity.finiteIndex_free_power_word_lower
statement:
theorem finiteIndex_free_power_word_lower (H : Subgroup G) [H.FiniteIndex] [IsFreeGroup H]
    (s : Finset G) (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set G) = ⊤) (h : H) (hh : h ≠ 1) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, κ * n ≤ (wordDistance s hgen 1 ((h : G) ^ n) : ℝ)

name: Singularity.avoidsBefore_prefix_iff
statement:
theorem avoidsBefore_prefix_iff (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (n : ℕ) (x : Γ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    avoidsBefore s A n x (walkPrefix s n ω) ↔
      ∀ k < n, walkPosition s x k ω ∉ A

name: Singularity.measurableSet_walkFirstEntranceEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_walkFirstEntranceEvent (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) (n : ℕ) :

name: Singularity.measurableSet_walkFirstEntranceEver
statement:
theorem measurableSet_walkFirstEntranceEver (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) :
    MeasurableSet (walkFirstEntranceEver s A x a)

name: Singularity.mem_walkFirstEntranceEvent
statement:
theorem mem_walkFirstEntranceEvent (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    ω ∈ walkFirstEntranceEvent s A x a n ↔
      (∀ k < n, walkPosition s x k ω ∉ A) ∧ walkPosition s x n ω = a ∧ a ∈ A

name: Singularity.walkFirstEntranceEvent_disjoint
statement:
theorem walkFirstEntranceEvent_disjoint (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) :
    Pairwise (fun n m => Disjoint (walkFirstEntranceEvent s A x a n) (walkFirstEntranceEvent s A x a m))

name: Singularity.walkFirstEntranceEvent_probability
statement:
theorem walkFirstEntranceEvent_probability (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass (walkFirstEntranceEvent s A x a n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (firstEntranceWeight s μ A n x a)

name: Singularity.walkFirstEntranceEver_disjoint
statement:
theorem walkFirstEntranceEver_disjoint (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x : Γ) :
    Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (walkFirstEntranceEver s A x a) (walkFirstEntranceEver s A x b))

name: Singularity.walk_hit_eq_union_firstEntrance
statement:
theorem walk_hit_eq_union_firstEntrance (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x : Γ) :
    {ω : ℕ → s | ∃ n, walkPosition s x n ω ∈ A} = ⋃ a : Γ, walkFirstEntranceEver s A x a

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_position_tail_independent
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_position_tail_independent [Group Γ] (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (x : Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    IndepFun (walkPosition s x n) (fun ω k => ω (k + n)) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_prefix_tail_independent
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_prefix_tail_independent (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    IndepFun (walkPrefix s n) (fun ω k => ω (k + n)) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)

name: Singularity.measurableSet_walkLastExitEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_walkLastExitEvent (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (hA : MeasurableSet A)

name: Singularity.measurableSet_walkLastExitEver
statement:
theorem measurableSet_walkLastExitEver (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (x a : Γ) :

name: Singularity.measurableSet_walkNoReturnEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_walkNoReturnEvent (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (a : Γ) :
    MeasurableSet (walkNoReturnEvent s A a)

name: Singularity.walkLastExitEvent_disjoint
statement:
theorem walkLastExitEvent_disjoint (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ) :
    Pairwise (fun n m => Disjoint (walkLastExitEvent s A x a n) (walkLastExitEvent s A x a m))

name: Singularity.walkLastExitEvent_eq_inter
statement:
theorem walkLastExitEvent_eq_inter (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x a : Γ)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (n : ℕ) :
    walkLastExitEvent s A x a n = {ω | walkPosition s x n ω = a} ∩
      (fun ω k => ω (k + n)) ⁻¹' walkNoReturnEvent s A a

name: Singularity.walkLastExitEvent_probability
statement:
theorem walkLastExitEvent_probability (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (A : Set Γ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (x a : Γ) (ha : a ∈ A) (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass (walkLastExitEvent s A x a n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (transitionWeight s μ n x a) *
        infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass (walkNoReturnEvent s A a)

name: Singularity.walkLastExitEver_disjoint
statement:
theorem walkLastExitEver_disjoint (s : Finset Γ) (A : Set Γ) (x : Γ) :
    Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (walkLastExitEver s A x a) (walkLastExitEver s A x b))

name: Singularity.exists_last_visit_of_eventually_avoid
statement:
theorem exists_last_visit_of_eventually_avoid {X : Type*} (f : ℕ → X) (A : Set X)
    (hzero : f 0 ∈ A) (havoid : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, f n ∉ A) :
    ∃ n, f n ∈ A ∧ ∀ k, n < k → f k ∉ A

name: Singularity.finiteLastExitVertex_fiber
statement:
theorem finiteLastExitVertex_fiber (s A : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (hx : x ∈ A) (a : A) :
    {ω | finiteLastExitVertex s A x hx ω = a} = walkLastExitEver s (A : Set Γ) x a ∪
      (if a = ⟨x, hx⟩ then (⋃ b : A, walkLastExitEver s (A : Set Γ) x b)ᶜ else ∅)

name: Singularity.finiteLastExitVertex_mem
statement:
theorem finiteLastExitVertex_mem (s A : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (hx : x ∈ A) (ω : ℕ → s)
    (h : ∃ a : A, ω ∈ walkLastExitEver s (A : Set Γ) x a) :
    ω ∈ walkLastExitEver s (A : Set Γ) x (finiteLastExitVertex s A x hx ω)

name: Singularity.finiteLastExitVertex_of_mem
statement:
theorem finiteLastExitVertex_of_mem (s A : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (hx : x ∈ A)
    (ω : ℕ → s) (a : A) (ha : ω ∈ walkLastExitEver s (A : Set Γ) x a) :
    finiteLastExitVertex s A x hx ω = a

name: Singularity.measurable_finiteLastExitVertex
statement:
theorem measurable_finiteLastExitVertex (s A : Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (hx : x ∈ A) :

name: Singularity.finiteMeasure_tendsto_zero_of_absolutelyContinuous
Singularity.finiteMeasure_uniform_absoluteContinuity
statement:
theorem finiteMeasure_uniform_absoluteContinuity {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (ν m : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [SigmaFinite m] (hac : ν ≪ m)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ S : Set X, m S < δ → ν S < ε

name: Singularity.exists_translate_disjoint_of_infinite_orbits
statement:
theorem exists_translate_disjoint_of_infinite_orbits {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (S T : Set X) (hS : S.Finite) (hT : T.Finite)
    (hinf : ∀ x ∈ S, (MulAction.orbit G x).Infinite) :

name: Singularity.stationaryRealDensity_finite_mixture_on_set
statement:
theorem stationaryRealDensity_finite_mixture_on_set
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace B] [MulAction Γ B] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ B]
    (ν : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hq : ∀ g : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (A : Finset Γ) (c : A → ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, 0 ≤ c a) (x : Γ)
    {E : Set B} (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (heq : (Measure.map (fun ξ : B => x • ξ) ν).restrict E =
      ∑ a : A, ENNReal.ofReal (c a) • (Measure.map (fun ξ : B => (a : Γ) • ξ) ν).restrict E) :
    ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ξ ∈ E → stationaryRealDensity ν x ξ =
      ∑ a : A, c a * stationaryRealDensity ν (a : Γ) ξ

name: Singularity.compact_tendsto_of_summable_escape
statement:
theorem compact_tendsto_of_summable_escape (z : ℕ → ℍ) (L : ℝ)
    (hjump : ∀ n, dist (z n) (z (n + 1)) ≤ L)
    (hs : Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-dist (z n) UpperHalfPlane.I))) :

name: Singularity.summable_radial_of_linear_escape
statement:

name: Singularity.walkPosition_hyperbolic_jump_bound

name: Singularity.walkPosition_last_step

name: Singularity.walk_ae_compact_convergence_of_summable_escape
statement:
theorem walk_ae_compact_convergence_of_summable_escape (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    [MeasurableSpace Γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass Γ]
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (x : Γ) (z : ℍ)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Summable (fun n => Real.exp (-dist (walkPosition s x n ω • z) UpperHalfPlane.I))) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      ∃ p : OnePoint ℂ, Tendsto

name: Singularity.orbit_radial_basepoint_bound

name: Singularity.exp_scaled_ratio_decay

theorem exp_scaled_ratio_decay {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) :

name: Singularity.summable_visualPoisson_orbits_sq

name: Singularity.visualPoisson_dilation_decay

name: Singularity.visualPoisson_zpow_decay

name: Singularity.greenDistance_column_orbit_bound
statement:
theorem greenDistance_column_orbit_bound (a b : Γ) {τ ξ : ℝ}
    (ha : (a : SL(2, ℝ)) = dilationMatrix τ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0)
    {t D : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (y : Γ)
    (hy : dist (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) (finiteBoundaryRay ξ t) ≤ D) (n : ℤ) :
    walkGreen s μ (a ^ n * b) y / walkGreen s μ 1 y ≤
      ((C ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * D)) * visualPoissonEnvelope (b • UpperHalfPlane.I) ξ) *
        Real.exp (-τ * |(n : ℝ)|)

name: Singularity.greenDistance_column_poisson_bound
statement:
theorem greenDistance_column_poisson_bound (ξ : ℝ) {t D : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (y g : Γ)
    (hy : dist (y • UpperHalfPlane.I) (finiteBoundaryRay ξ t) ≤ D) :
    walkGreen s μ g y / walkGreen s μ 1 y ≤

name: Singularity.greenDistance_row_poisson_bound

theorem greenDistance_row_poisson_bound (ξ : ℝ) {t D : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (x g : Γ)

name: Singularity.cocompact_exists_beyond_sequence
statement:
theorem cocompact_exists_beyond_sequence (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ))
    [CompactSpace (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel Γ ℍ))] :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ x : Γ, ∃ y : ℕ → Γ,
      (∀ z, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, z ≠ y n) ∧ ∀ n,
      dist UpperHalfPlane.I (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) +
        dist (y n • UpperHalfPlane.I) (x • UpperHalfPlane.I) -
        dist UpperHalfPlane.I (y n • UpperHalfPlane.I) ≤ D

name: Singularity.inverse_orbit_map_measureClass

theorem inverse_orbit_map_measureClass {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MeasurableSpace G]

    [MulAction G X] [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] [MeasurableSMul₂ G X]

    (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ] [NeZero μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ] (x : X) :

name: Singularity.orbit_preimage_null_iff
statement:
theorem orbit_preimage_null_iff {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MeasurableSpace G]

name: Singularity.exists_invariant_conull_subset
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_conull_subset {G X : Type*} [Group G] [Countable G]

name: Singularity.exists_invariant_equivalent_restriction
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_equivalent_restriction
    {Γ X : Type*} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MulAction Γ X] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ X]
    (ν m : Measure X) [SigmaFinite ν] [SigmaFinite m] (hac : ν ≪ m)
    (hq : ∀ g : Γ, Measure.map (fun x : X => g • x) ν ≪ ν) :
    ∃ E : Set X, MeasurableSet E ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ E) ∧
      (∀ g : Γ, (fun x : X => g • x) ⁻¹' E = E) ∧
      (ν ≪ m.restrict E) ∧ (m.restrict E ≪ ν) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ E, 0 < ν.rnDeriv m x ∧ ν.rnDeriv m x < ∞

theorem densityFactorization_inner (Kminus Kplus : DensityFamily ℝ ι volume)

theorem inner_integral_operator_integral {E F : Type*}

name: Singularity.commonSubtraction_harmonic
statement:
theorem commonSubtraction_harmonic (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ → Γ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (o : Γ) (f : Γ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : Γ)
    (hf : f x = ∑ g ∈ s, μ g * f (x*g))
    (hk : ∀ j < n, k j x = ∑ g ∈ s, μ g * k j (x*g)) :
    commonSubtraction k c o f n x = ∑ g ∈ s, μ g * commonSubtraction k c o f n (x*g)

name: Singularity.commonSubtraction_memLp
statement:
theorem commonSubtraction_memLp (k : ℕ → Γ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (o : Γ) (f : Γ → ℝ)

    (hk : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (k n x : ℂ)) 2 Measure.count) (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun x => (commonSubtraction k c o f n x : ℂ)) 2 Measure.count

name: Singularity.killedGreen_commonSubtraction_contraction
statement:
theorem killedGreen_commonSubtraction_contraction (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (A : ℕ → Set Γ) (z : ℕ → Γ) (o : Γ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (f g : Γ → ℝ) (S : ℕ → Set Γ) (N : ℕ)
    (hden : ∀ n, killedGreen s μ (A n) o (z n) ≠ 0)
    (hfg : f o = g o) (hS : ∀ n < N, S (n+1) ⊆ S n)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ S 0, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x ∈ S 0, 0 ≤ g x)
    (hcompare : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g} : Set (Γ → ℝ)), ∀ n < N, ∀ x ∈ S (n+1),
      let r := commonSubtraction (fun j => normalizedKilledGreen s μ (A j) o (z j)) (1/C) o u n
      r o * normalizedKilledGreen s μ (A n) o (z n) x / C ≤ r x ∧
      r x ≤ C * (r o * normalizedKilledGreen s μ (A n) o (z n) x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ S N, |f x - g x| ≤ (1-1/C^2)^N * (f x + g x)

    (s : Finset Γ) (A : ℕ → Finset Γ) (x : Γ) (hx : ∀ n, x ∈ A n)
    (hexhaust : ∀ g, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, g ∈ A n) (ω : ℕ → s)
    (hescape : ∀ n, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, walkPosition s x k ω ∉ A n)

    (hlim : Tendsto (fun k => orbit (walkPosition s x k ω)) atTop (𝓝 b)) :

name: Singularity.slTwo_parabolic_normalization
statement:

name: Singularity.linear_word_growth_of_finiteIndex_free
statement:
theorem linear_word_growth_of_finiteIndex_free (H : Subgroup G) [H.FiniteIndex] [IsFreeGroup H]

name: Singularity.cayley_chain_bound
statement:
theorem cayley_chain_bound (p : ℕ → ℍ) (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ k < N, dist (p k) (p (k + 1)) ≤ L) :
    dist (halfPlaneCayley (p 0)) (halfPlaneCayley (p N)) ≤
      4 * Real.exp L * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, Real.exp (-dist UpperHalfPlane.I (p k))

name: Singularity.cayley_quasigeodesic_envelope
statement:
theorem cayley_quasigeodesic_envelope (p : ℕ → ℍ) (N m : ℕ) (a b L : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hstep : ∀ k < N, dist (p k) (p (k + 1)) ≤ L)
    (hmin : ∀ k < N, dist UpperHalfPlane.I (p m) ≤ dist UpperHalfPlane.I (p k))
    (hlower : ∀ k < N, a * |(k : ℝ) - (m : ℝ)| - b ≤ dist (p k) (p m)) :
    dist (halfPlaneCayley (p 0)) (halfPlaneCayley (p N)) ≤
      4 * Real.exp L * (Real.exp (-dist UpperHalfPlane.I (p m) / 2 + b / 4) *
        latticeEnvelopeBound (a / 4))

name: Singularity.nearest_vertex_exp_bound
statement:
theorem nearest_vertex_exp_bound {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (p : ℕ → X) (o : X) (a b : ℝ) (m k : ℕ)
    (hmin : dist o (p m) ≤ dist o (p k))
    (hlower : a * |(k : ℝ) - (m : ℝ)| - b ≤ dist (p k) (p m)) :
    Real.exp (-dist o (p k)) ≤
      Real.exp (-dist o (p m) / 2 + b / 4) *
        Real.exp (-(a / 4) * |(k : ℝ) - (m : ℝ)|)

name: Singularity.sum_exp_nat_distance_le

name: Singularity.relativePairTransfer_monoOn
statement:
theorem relativePairTransfer_monoOn (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (A : Set Γ) (B : Finset Γ) (last : Bool) (S S' : Set (Γ × Γ))
    (hmove : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ b : B, (if last then (p.1, (b : Γ)) else ((b : Γ), p.2)) ∈ S')
    (f g : Γ × Γ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ p ∈ S', f p ≤ g p) :
    ∀ p ∈ S, relativePairTransfer s μ A B last f p ≤ relativePairTransfer s μ A B last g p

name: Singularity.shadow_estimates_of_positive_inverse_mass
statement:
theorem shadow_estimates_of_positive_inverse_mass
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace B] [MulAction Γ B]
    [MeasurableConstSMul Γ B] (ν : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hq : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (htotal : ν univ ≤ 1) (g : Γ) {S : Set B} (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (D C : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hmass : ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' S))
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, g • ξ ∈ S → |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D - (C - Real.log c))) ≤ ν S ∧
      ν S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-D + (C - Real.log c)))) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, g • ξ ∈ S → |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C - Real.log c

name: Singularity.bounded_magnitude_difference_of_shadow_ratio_limit
statement:
theorem bounded_magnitude_difference_of_shadow_ratio_limit {B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace B]
    (ν m : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m]
    (S : ℕ → Set B) (Dν Dm : ℕ → ℝ) (Cν Cm : ℝ)
    (hνl : ∀ n, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν n - Cν)) ≤ ν (S n))
    (hνu : ∀ n, ν (S n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν n + Cν)))
    (hml : ∀ n, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm n - Cm)) ≤ m (S n))
    (hmu : ∀ n, m (S n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm n + Cm)))
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hratio : Tendsto (fun n => (ν (S n)).toReal / (m (S n)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 ρ)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, |Dν n - Dm n| ≤ C

name: Singularity.magnitude_rigidity_of_shadow_return_cover
statement:
theorem magnitude_rigidity_of_shadow_return_cover {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ]
    [MeasurableSpace B] [MulAction Γ B] [MeasurableConstSMul Γ B]
    (ν m : Measure B) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure m]
    (hac : ν ≪ m) (hreverse : m ≪ ν)
    (hν : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) ν ≪ ν)
    (hm : ∀ a : Γ, Measure.map (fun ξ : B => a • ξ) m ≪ m)
    (S : Γ → Set B) (Dν Dm : Γ → ℝ) (Cν Cm : ℝ)
    (hνl : ∀ a, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν a - Cν)) ≤ ν (S a))
    (hνu : ∀ a, ν (S a) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dν a + Cν)))
    (hml : ∀ a, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm a - Cm)) ≤ m (S a))
    (hmu : ∀ a, m (S a) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Dm a + Cm)))
    (hνshadow : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a : Γ, a • ξ ∈ S a →
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν a ξ - Dν a| ≤ Cν)
    (hmshadow : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a : Γ, a • ξ ∈ S a →
      |stationaryLogCocycle m a ξ - Dm a| ≤ Cm)
    (g : ℕ → Γ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hratio : Tendsto (fun n => (ν (S (g n))).toReal / (m (S (g n))).toReal) atTop (𝓝 ρ))
    (F : Finset Γ) (M J : ℝ)
    (hcorrection : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∀ a ∈ F,
      |stationaryLogCocycle ν a ξ - stationaryLogCocycle m a ξ| ≤ J)
    (hcover : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ n : ℕ,
      g n • (a⁻¹ • ξ) ∈ S (g n) ∧
      |Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv m (g n • (a⁻¹ • ξ))).toReal)| ≤ M) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Γ, |Dν a - Dm a| ≤ C

name: Singularity.axisPairSet_radial_depth
statement:
theorem axisPairSet_radial_depth (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℝ)) (g q : SL(2, ℝ))
    (E l r a H : ℝ) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hleft : a+H+(l+r)/50+E ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I (-l))))
    (hright : a+H+(l+r)/50+E ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (g • verticalHeightRay UpperHalfPlane.I r)))
    (n : ℕ) (xy : Γ × Γ) (hxy : xy ∈ axisPairSet Γ g E (axisInterval l r n)) :

      a+H ≤ axisRadialCoordinate (q • (xy.2 • UpperHalfPlane.I))

name: Singularity.stationary_atom_balance

name: Singularity.stationary_maximal_atom_generated

name: Singularity.axisRatioStrip_cayley_separation

name: Singularity.inverse_shadow_error_of_translated_concentration
statement:
theorem inverse_shadow_error_of_translated_concentration
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace B] [MulAction Γ B]

name: Singularity.relative_shadow_error_le_translated_complement
statement:
theorem relative_shadow_error_le_translated_complement (g : Γ) {S E : Set B}
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (D C : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmass : c ≤ (ν ((fun ξ : B => g • ξ) ⁻¹' S)).toReal)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ν, g • ξ ∈ S → |stationaryLogCocycle ν g ξ - D| ≤ C) :
    (ν (S \ E)).toReal / (ν S).toReal ≤

name: Singularity.relative_shadow_error_tendsto_zero_of_translated_concentration

name: Singularity.poissonBoundaryMeasure_le_exp_dist
statement:
theorem poissonBoundaryMeasure_le_exp_dist (z : ℍ) :
    poissonBoundaryMeasure z ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (dist UpperHalfPlane.I z)) •
      poissonBoundaryMeasure UpperHalfPlane.I

name: Singularity.visualPoisson_le_exp_dist
statement:
theorem visualPoisson_le_exp_dist (z : ℍ) (ξ : ℝ) :
    visualPoisson z ξ ≤ Real.exp (dist UpperHalfPlane.I z)

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryMap_time_cocycle
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryMap_time_cocycle
    {Γ B : Type*} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass Γ]
    [MulAction Γ B] (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1)
    (b : (ℕ → s) → B)
    (hstep : ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      b ω = (ω 0 : Γ) • b (fun k => ω (k + 1))) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      b ω = walkPosition s 1 n ω • b (fun k => ω (k + n))

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_condExp_prefix_tendsto
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_condExp_prefix_tendsto
    {Γ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass Γ]
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g)
    (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (f : (ℕ → s) → ℝ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hint : Integrable f (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Tendsto (fun n => (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)[f | walkPrefixFiltration s n] ω)
        atTop (𝓝 (f ω))

name: Singularity.walkPrefixFiltration_eq_comap
statement:
theorem walkPrefixFiltration_eq_comap (S : Type*) [MeasurableSpace S] (n : ℕ) :
    walkPrefixFiltration S n = MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun (ω : ℕ → S) (i : Fin n) => ω i.val) inferInstance

name: Singularity.walkPrefixFiltration_iSup
statement:
theorem walkPrefixFiltration_iSup (S : Type*) [MeasurableSpace S] :
    (⨆ n, walkPrefixFiltration S n) = (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ℕ → S))

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_condExp_prefix_tail
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_condExp_prefix_tail
    {Γ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass Γ]
    (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g)
    (hmass : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (n : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin n → s) → (ℕ → s) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ w, Measurable (f w))
    (hint : ∀ w, Integrable (f w) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)) :
    (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)[
      fun ω => f (fun i => ω i.val) (fun k => ω (k + n)) | walkPrefixFiltration s n] =ᵐ[
        infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass]
      fun ω => ∫ η, f (fun i => ω i.val) η ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLaw_condExp_event
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLaw_condExp_event {E : Set B} (hE : MeasurableSet E) (n : ℕ) :
    (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass)[(b ⁻¹' E).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) |
        walkPrefixFiltration s n] =ᵐ[infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass]
      fun ω => (walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b
        ((fun ξ : B => walkPosition s 1 n ω • ξ) ⁻¹' E)).toReal

name: Singularity.walkBoundaryLaw_event_concentration
statement:
theorem walkBoundaryLaw_event_concentration {E : Set B} (hE : MeasurableSet E) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hmass,
      Tendsto (fun n => (walkBoundaryLaw s μ hμ hmass b
        ((fun ξ : B => walkPosition s 1 n ω • ξ) ⁻¹' E)).toReal)
        atTop (𝓝 ((b ⁻¹' E).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω))

name: Singularity.infiniteWalkLaw_transport
statement:
theorem infiniteWalkLaw_transport (s : Finset Γ) (t : Finset Λ) (e : s ≃ t)
    (μ : Γ → ℝ) (ν : Λ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hν : ∀ g ∈ t, 0 ≤ ν g)
    (hm : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (hn : ∑ g ∈ t, ν g = 1)
    (hw : ∀ g : s, ν (e g) = μ g) :
    Measure.map (transportWalk s t e) (infiniteWalkLaw s μ hμ hm) =
      infiniteWalkLaw t ν hν hn

name: Singularity.measurable_transportWalk
statement:
theorem measurable_transportWalk (s : Finset Γ) (t : Finset Λ) (e : s ≃ t) :
    Measurable (transportWalk s t e)

name: Singularity.supportJumpLaw_transport
statement:
theorem supportJumpLaw_transport (s : Finset Γ) (t : Finset Λ) (e : s ≃ t)
    (μ : Γ → ℝ) (ν : Λ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ g) (hν : ∀ g ∈ t, 0 ≤ ν g)
    (hm : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) (hn : ∑ g ∈ t, ν g = 1)
    (hw : ∀ g : s, ν (e g) = μ g) :
    (supportJumpLaw s μ hμ hm).map e = supportJumpLaw t ν hν hn

name: Singularity.walkPosition_transport
statement:
theorem walkPosition_transport (s : Finset Γ) (t : Finset Λ) (e : s ≃ t)
    (φ : Γ →* Λ) (he : ∀ g : s, (e g : Λ) = φ g)
    (x : Γ) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → s) :
    walkPosition t (φ x) n (transportWalk s t e ω) = φ (walkPosition s x n ω)

name: Singularity.mappedSupport_generates
statement:
theorem mappedSupport_generates (e : Γ ≃* Λ) (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) :
    Submonoid.closure (s.map e.toEmbedding : Set Λ) = ⊤

name: Singularity.mappedSupport_mass
statement:
theorem mappedSupport_mass (e : Γ ≃* Λ) (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hm : ∑ g ∈ s, μ g = 1) :
    ∑ g ∈ s.map e.toEmbedding, (μ ∘ e.symm) g = 1

name: Singularity.mappedSupport_positive
statement:
theorem mappedSupport_positive (e : Γ ≃* Λ) (s : Finset Γ) (μ : Γ → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ g ∈ s, 0 < μ g) :
    ∀ g ∈ s.map e.toEmbedding, 0 < (μ ∘ e.symm) g

name: Singularity.noInvariantMean_of_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem noInvariantMean_of_mulEquiv (e : Γ ≃* Λ) (hNA : ¬HasInvariantMean Γ) :
    ¬HasInvariantMean Λ

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_chain_le
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_chain_le (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (p : ℕ → Γ) (N : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ k < N, ∃ g ∈ s, p (k + 1) = p k * g)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    jumpDistance s hgen (p i) (p j) ≤ j - i

name: Singularity.jumpDistance_shortest_chain
statement:
theorem jumpDistance_shortest_chain (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (p : ℕ → Γ) (N : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ k < N, ∃ g ∈ s, p (k + 1) = p k * g)
    (hshort : jumpDistance s hgen (p 0) (p N) = N)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    jumpDistance s hgen (p i) (p j) = j - i

name: Singularity.walkWord_vertex_chain
statement:
theorem walkWord_vertex_chain (s : Finset Γ) (n : ℕ) (w : WalkWord s n) (x : Γ) :
    ∃ p : ℕ → Γ, p 0 = x ∧ p n = walkEndpoint s n x w ∧
      ∀ k < n, ∃ g ∈ s, p (k + 1) = p k * g

name: Singularity.wordDistance_geodesic_chain
statement:
theorem wordDistance_geodesic_chain (s : Finset Γ)
    (hgen : Submonoid.closure (s : Set Γ) = ⊤) (x y : Γ) :
    ∃ p : ℕ → Γ, p 0 = x ∧ p (wordDistance s hgen x y) = y ∧
      (∀ k < wordDistance s hgen x y,
        ∃ g ∈ symmetricWordSupport s, p (k + 1) = p k * g) ∧
      (∀ i ≤ wordDistance s hgen x y, ∀ j ≤ wordDistance s hgen x y,
        (wordDistance s hgen (p i) (p j) : ℝ) = |(i : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)|)
